Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, he can follow up with Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy while you are stunned. Keep minions between you and move unpredictably. When Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, spread out from your team and create distance before Amumu gets close.
Amumu.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Amumu deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. Amumu W Despair deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only health.
Amumu.fight: Brand has no escape ability, so trade damage while staying far enough away to dodge Amumu Q Bandage Toss. Apply Blaze to Amumu, then stun him with Brand Q Sear from an angle where minions cannot block the projectile. Hit him with Brand W Pillar of Flame during the stun.
Amumu.laning: Stand behind minions to block Amumu Q Bandage Toss and poke from long range with Brand W Pillar of Flame. After using Brand W Pillar of Flame, stay out of Amumu's engage range. Look for an all-in when you can hit a target affected by Blaze with Brand Q Sear.
Amumu.combo: From long range, apply Blaze to Amumu with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun him with Brand Q Sear. If he is already close, apply Blaze first with Brand E Conflagration, use Brand Q Sear, and hit him with Brand W Pillar of Flame during the stun.
Amumu.escape: Go in after Amumu Q Bandage Toss misses or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is used. Amumu has no ability to create distance himself, so find an angle to apply Blaze first and stun him with Brand Q Sear.
Amumu.phase: Brand is strongest in mid game as he builds ability power. In late game, focus on positioning so you do not get caught first.
Amumu.teamfight: When Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, keep space between yourself and your allies and fight in open areas. Attack the front line from the back. When enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. Save Brand R Pyroclasm if they spread out.

Alistar.watch: If Alistar catches Brand with Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize, Brand's lack of mobility makes him vulnerable to the follow-up Alistar E Trample. Stay outside Alistar's engage range. Near your turret, do not give him room to get behind you and knock you in.
Alistar.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Alistar's magic damage and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Add Morellonomicon if the healing from Alistar P Triumphant Roar becomes a problem.
Alistar.fight: Trade when the target is affected by Blaze and you have a clear path for Brand Q Sear. Right after Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are used, reset your spacing and counterattack. If Alistar activates Alistar R Unbreakable Will, back off and fight again after it expires.
Alistar.laning: Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame, but stay outside Alistar W Headbutt range. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so look for a stun when you have a clear projectile path to Alistar while he is affected by Blaze. Even when defending near your turret, deny Alistar room to get behind you.
Alistar.combo: From range, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand E Conflagration. If Alistar is already close, apply Blaze first with Brand E Conflagration, then hit Brand Q Sear. A new stun still works after Alistar activates Alistar R Unbreakable Will, so use this sequence to stop his engage if you cannot retreat.
Alistar.escape: Right after Alistar uses Alistar W Headbutt, he has no mobility ability available, giving you a window to counterattack. If Alistar Q Pulverize is also down, use that time to close the distance or reposition, then look to stun Alistar with Brand Q Sear while he is affected by Blaze.
Alistar.phase: Early on, keep your distance to avoid Alistar's combo. In late game, focus on positioning: if you get caught first, you cannot deal damage.
Alistar.teamfight: From the back, when enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. Blaze's damage based on maximum health is effective against the front line too, so do not move forward to target damage dealers. Do not commit your damage while Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active. If you need to stop his engage, apply Blaze and stun him with Brand Q Sear.

Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley is a cone-shaped slowing poke ability, so sidestep it. The slow from Ashe P Frost Shot refreshes with each basic attack, so do not stay in her basic attack range for long. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, do not start a skirmish from outside your vision. If the arrow comes toward you, change direction as you move.
Ashe.build: Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Brand has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to survive early on and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Ashe.fight: Right after Ashe W Volley is used is a chance to trade. Apply Blaze first with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun her with Brand Q Sear from a path minions cannot block. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, then look for another opening after it ends.
Ashe.laning: Poke Ashe with Brand W Pillar of Flame when she steps forward to last-hit. Try to sidestep Ashe W Volley, and do not remain in her basic attack range after poking. If you apply Blaze to a minion, you can spread it to Ashe with Brand E Conflagration when she stands nearby.
Ashe.combo: From long range, apply Blaze to Ashe with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun her with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand E Conflagration. If she is already close, apply Blaze with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear only stuns if Ashe is affected by Blaze and no minion blocks its projectile path.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no mobility ability to create distance herself, so look for an approach after Ashe W Volley or Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is used. Apply Blaze to Ashe first, then stun her with Brand Q Sear to deal follow-up damage while she cannot escape.
Ashe.phase: Early on, watch for Ashe's basic attack slow and poke, and compensate for Brand's low armor. In late game, hold a safe position so you are not picked off first, and deal area damage.
Ashe.teamfight: From the back, when enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. Use Blaze's explosion damage against the front line instead of moving forward to catch Ashe. If enemies spread out and Brand R Pyroclasm is unlikely to bounce, save it and maintain Blaze on the front line with Brand E Conflagration and Brand W Pillar of Flame.

Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so do not stand with a wall behind you or line up with an ally or minion. Targets hit by Bard R Tempered Fate cannot take damage, so do not use Brand's damage abilities on them during that time. Bard E Magical Journey can let him approach from the side, so watch your flanks.
Bard.fight: Focus Brand's trades on stacking Blaze and triggering its explosion. Look for a stun when Bard is affected by Blaze and Brand Q Sear is ready. Right after Bard E Magical Journey is used, close the distance and find another angle.
Bard.combo: From range, apply Blaze first with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then look for a stun with Brand Q Sear. If Bard is close, applying Blaze with Brand E Conflagration before using Brand Q Sear is faster. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check its projectile path, then place Brand W Pillar of Flame on the stunned target.
Bard.escape: Right after Bard E Magical Journey is used is Brand's window to go in. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is also down or you have positioned to avoid its stun, close the distance, apply Blaze, then lock him down with Brand Q Sear. Follow Bard through an escape portal only if you judge it safe.
Bard.phase: Brand's damage peaks in mid game as he builds ability power. In late game, he is easier to pick off first, so position in the back before fighting.
Bard.teamfight: From the back, when enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. Do not use damage abilities while Bard R Tempered Fate makes targets immune to damage. If enemies spread out and Brand R Pyroclasm is unlikely to keep bouncing, save it and maintain Blaze on the front line.

Blitzcrank.watch: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab hits, he can pull you in and follow with the knockup from Blitzcrank E Power Fist and the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field. Brand has no escape ability, so keep minions between you and Blitzcrank and stay away from bushes without vision.
Blitzcrank.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Blitzcrank's main damage sources, Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field.
Blitzcrank.fight: Trade right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or when Blitzcrank is low on mana. Apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration, then stun with Brand Q Sear from an angle clear of minions and keep attacking.
Blitzcrank.laning: Keep minions between Brand and Blitzcrank to block Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Poke the enemy marksman with Brand W Pillar of Flame when they step up for a last hit, then back away. Secure vision in bushes and keep your distance from bushes without vision.
Blitzcrank.combo: From range, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand E Conflagration. When the target is close, use Brand E Conflagration before Brand Q Sear.
Blitzcrank.escape: Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is your chance to step forward and trade. Since Blitzcrank has no escape ability, stunning him with Brand Q Sear while Blaze is active lets you keep attacking.
Blitzcrank.phase: Early on, survive by dodging Blitzcrank's grab and use the opening when it misses. Later, hold a safe position so you are not caught first.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Stay in the back and wait for enemies to group. Apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If enemies are spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Blaze on the frontline. Do not step forward to catch Blitzcrank and give him a grab angle.

Braum.watch: Dodge Braum Q Winter's Bite from behind minions. If you get a stack of Braum P Concussive Blows, move out of range before the stacks fill. Save Brand Q Sear while Braum E Unbreakable blocks the front, and sidestep out of the line when you see Braum R Glacial Fissure begin casting.
Braum.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to increase your magic resistance. Choose Mercury's Treads for your boots to help against Braum's crowd control.
Braum.fight: Apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun with Brand Q Sear from an angle clear of minions and follow up with damage. Brand has no escape ability, so do not extend trades within range of Braum Q Winter's Bite or Braum P Concussive Blows.
Braum.laning: Stand behind minions to avoid the straight path of Braum Q Winter's Bite. Poke the enemy marksman with Brand W Pillar of Flame when they step up for a last hit, then retreat out of Braum's range.
Braum.combo: Apply Blaze to Braum with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration, then hit Brand Q Sear to stun him. If Braum E Unbreakable blocks the path of Brand Q Sear, wait for the shield to drop or for an angle outside the direction Braum faces.
Braum.escape: Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is used is your chance to close the distance and catch him with Brand Q Sear. Brand has trouble escaping if hit by Braum Q Winter's Bite or Braum R Glacial Fissure, so check their paths before moving in.
Braum.phase: Early on, Brand is vulnerable if caught, so keep your distance and minions in position while poking. Later, position in the back to avoid being picked off first.
Braum.teamfight: When enemies group, apply Blaze from the back with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If Braum E Unbreakable blocks the front, do not rush Brand Q Sear, and move out of the line of Braum R Glacial Fissure.

Briar.watch: If Briar closes the distance with Briar Q Head Rush and Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, Brand's lack of an escape ability makes him vulnerable to follow-up hits. When Briar charges Briar E Chilling Scream, do not stand with your back to a wall, and ready Brand Q Sear for a stun. If Briar R Certain Death's projectile hits you and makes you its target, move toward your allies and fight back together instead of fleeing alone.
Briar.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Briar's main damage is physical and Brand's armor is relatively low, so build armor first. If Briar's healing becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Briar.fight: When Briar engages, keep your distance, apply Blaze, and stun her with Brand Q Sear to fight back. Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack makes her chase nearby targets, so fight from behind your frontline. Aim to deal Brand P Blaze's damage based on maximum health, but take the fight when you can follow up with the abilities needed to build its stacks.
Briar.laning: In lane, poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block, then do not remain within Briar's dash range. You can apply Blaze to a minion and use Brand E Conflagration to spread it to Briar if she is standing nearby. If you push the wave, establish vision and do not linger in the middle of the lane where you lack vision.
Briar.combo: If Briar is already close, apply Blaze with Brand E Conflagration, stun with Brand Q Sear, then place Brand W Pillar of Flame at her position. If starting from range, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame before landing Brand Q Sear. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check the projectile's path.
Briar.escape: Do not engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down; check whether she has also used Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. An opportunity to engage comes before Briar R Certain Death is available again, when you can hit a Briar affected by Blaze with Brand Q Sear. If Briar starts charging Briar E Chilling Scream, you can also interrupt it with Brand Q Sear's stun.
Briar.phase: Early on, Briar has high kill participation and engages often, so secure vision and keep your distance. In the late game, hold your position so Brand isn't picked off first while dealing area damage.
Briar.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and counter Briar's engage without stepping forward yourself. When enemies group, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If enemies spread out and Brand R Pyroclasm is unlikely to continue bouncing, save it and maintain Blaze on the frontline with Brand E Conflagration and Brand W Pillar of Flame.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves and applies a mark, so dodge sideways instead of retreating in a straight line. If you are marked, create distance because Diana E Lunar Rush can be used again. In teamfights, spread out so Diana R Moonfall does not pull in several allies at once.
Diana.build: Diana's damage is mostly magic, and Brand's magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Diana.fight: Start trading after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone. If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without a mark, apply Blaze with Brand E Conflagration and stun her with Brand Q Sear to fight back. If you are marked, create distance instead of trying to catch her.
Diana.laning: Save Brand Q Sear to stun Diana while she is affected by Blaze, and check for minions in the projectile's path.
Diana.combo: When starting from long range, apply the mark with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then build stacks with Brand E Conflagration. If Diana is already close, apply the mark first with Brand E Conflagration, then land Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear stops at the first enemy it hits, so use it from an angle where minions won't block it.
Diana.escape: Right after Diana engages with Diana E Lunar Rush without a mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike is your chance to fight back. Apply Blaze with Brand E Conflagration, stun her with Brand Q Sear, then adjust your distance. If you are marked by Diana Q Crescent Strike, do not move in because Diana E Lunar Rush can be used again.
Diana.phase: Later, position in the back to avoid being picked off first.
Diana.teamfight: Watch for Diana's flank and keep space between yourself and your allies so Diana R Moonfall does not pull you in together. When enemies group, apply Blaze from the back with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If enemies are spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and build Blaze stacks on the frontline with Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand E Conflagration.

Ekko.watch: When you see Ekko W Parallel Convergence being cast, move out of the marked area. Watch where Ekko Q Timewinder travels and avoid its return path too. After Ekko E Phase Dive closes the gap, watch for his empowered basic attack and the movement speed from Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance.
Ekko.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ekko deals mainly magic damage, and Brand has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon.
Ekko.fight: Look for an opening right after Ekko E Phase Dive closes the gap, but apply Blaze first if you want to stun him with Brand Q Sear. Avoid the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence and commit to a fight after Ekko R Chronobreak is down. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, do not overextend to chase him even if he looks low on health.
Ekko.laning: Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame, placing it ahead of Ekko's movement. After poking, back off so he cannot close the gap with Ekko E Phase Dive. Avoid the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder and the marked area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence, then look for a moment when Blaze is applied and Brand Q Sear is ready.
Ekko.combo: From a distance, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun Ekko with Brand Q Sear. If he closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, apply Blaze first with Brand E Conflagration, land Brand Q Sear, then place Brand W Pillar of Flame on him. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check its projectile path.
Ekko.escape: Right after Ekko uses Ekko E Phase Dive, his mobility spell is down, giving you a chance to apply Blaze and stun him with Brand Q Sear. Commit to a fight when Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are also down. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, do not go too deep; he can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak.
Ekko.phase: Mid game, as ability power builds up, is when Brand's damage peaks, so look for openings while Ekko R Chronobreak is down. Late game, Brand is more likely to get picked off first, so focus on positioning.
Ekko.teamfight: From the backline, when enemies are grouped, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, look to stun him with Brand Q Sear while Blaze is applied. Stay out of the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence, and save Brand R Pyroclasm if the enemies have spread out.

Elise.watch: If Elise switches to Elise R Spider Form and approaches Brand while he is low on health, treat it as an attempt to finish him off and keep your distance. While Elise is airborne with Elise E Rappel, hold Brand E Conflagration and wait for her to land.
Elise.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Elise deals mainly magic damage, and the stun from Elise E Cocoon is also dangerous, so prioritize magic resistance and tenacity. If the healing from Elise P Spider Queen becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon.
Elise.fight: After dodging Elise E Cocoon or blocking it with a minion, apply Brand P Blaze first, then look to stun Elise with Brand Q Sear.
Elise.laning: Keep plenty of vision early and do not push the lane too far when Elise is missing. Stay behind minions to block the path of Elise E Cocoon, poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then back out of her range. Using Brand E Conflagration on a minion affected by Blaze can spread Blaze to a nearby Elise.
Elise.combo: Apply Blaze to Elise with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then land Brand Q Sear to stun her. If you can reliably start at close range, apply Blaze first with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand Q Sear. Hold Brand E Conflagration while Elise is using Elise E Rappel, and place Brand W Pillar of Flame where she will land.
Elise.escape: Once both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down, turn around and pressure her.
Elise.phase: Early on, watch for Elise trying to gain an advantage through ganks and focus on avoiding deaths. Late game, position to avoid getting caught first while dealing area damage.
Elise.teamfight: From the backline, watch for Elise engaging and stack Brand P Blaze on the frontline. When enemies are grouped, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If the enemies are too spread out for Brand R Pyroclasm to bounce easily, save it and maintain Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand E Conflagration.

Evelynn.watch: When the mark from Evelynn W Allure appears, back off before the charm completes and alert your team.
Evelynn.build: Evelynn deals mainly magic damage, so build magic resistance first with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. If the healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon.
Evelynn.fight: Keep your distance before the mark from Evelynn W Allure fully charges. Once she engages and reveals herself, look to stun her with Brand Q Sear. When starting a fight, apply Blaze first and make sure no minion is in the projectile path of Brand Q Sear.
Evelynn.laning: Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame when your opponent steps up to last-hit, then leave the dangerous range after using it. Bring a Control Ward and place vision near jungle camps where Evelynn could start a fight.
Evelynn.combo: If Evelynn gets close, apply Blaze with Brand E Conflagration, then land Brand Q Sear to stun her. If you can start from a distance, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun her with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand E Conflagration.
Evelynn.escape: Do not go in just because Evelynn E Whiplash is down. Look to engage before Evelynn R Last Caress is available again and when you can stun her with Brand Q Sear.
Evelynn.phase: Late game, focus on positioning so you do not get picked off first.
Evelynn.teamfight: Stay in the backline of an area your team has vision of, and hold Brand Q Sear for Evelynn's engage. When enemies are grouped, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If the enemies are spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and maintain Blaze on the frontline.

Fiddlesticks.watch: When you see Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channeling, interrupt with Brand Q Sear if Fiddlesticks has Blaze and the projectile has a clear path. If you can’t interrupt, move out of range. When Fiddlesticks has been out of sight for a while, watch for an ultimate from a brush. Fiddlesticks’s abilities can apply Terrify when they hit you from out of sight, so be careful in unwarded corridors.
Fiddlesticks.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Fiddlesticks deals mainly magic damage, and Brand has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance. If the healing from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon.
Fiddlesticks.fight: Apply Blaze first, then stun Fiddlesticks with Brand Q Sear and land Brand W Pillar of Flame where he is stunned. If Fiddlesticks engages first, move out of his ultimate's area before fighting back.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame, but do not stay within Fiddlesticks' attack range after using it. Around jungle gank timings, keep vision in the brush behind the lane, and do not pass close to a stationary Scarecrow Effigy before checking it. Use Brand Q Sear when you can hit Fiddlesticks while Blaze is applied without a minion blocking it.
Fiddlesticks.combo: If starting at close range, use Brand E Conflagration → Brand Q Sear → Brand W Pillar of Flame. If you need to interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest or stop the channel of Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, apply Blaze first and hold Brand Q Sear for that moment.
Fiddlesticks.escape: If Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap are also down, find the right distance, apply Blaze, then look to stun him with Brand Q Sear.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Late game, prioritize positioning and vision, since you can do little if you get caught first.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, Fiddlesticks E Reap, and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm all hit an area, so spread out from your teammates and do not enter narrow corridors without vision as a group. From the backline, when enemies group up, Brand should apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If Fiddlesticks engages with Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, move out of its area and use Brand Q Sear if the conditions to interrupt him are met.

Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, move outside its radius. Keep your distance: getting hit by Gragas E Body Slam near the barrel can lead into Gragas R Explosive Cask. When Gragas has Gragas R Explosive Cask available, do not stand with the enemy turret or enemy team behind you.
Gragas.build: Early on, sustain with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Gragas deals mostly magic damage, and Brand has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Gragas P Happy Hour becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Gragas.fight: Do not start a trade within range of Gragas E Body Slam. Right after Gragas uses it, close the gap, apply fire with Brand E Conflagration, and look for a stun with Brand Q Sear. If Gragas starts drinking with Gragas W Drunken Rage, wait for its damage reduction to end before using your burst.
Gragas.laning: Poke from range with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then leave the range of Gragas E Body Slam. Brand W Pillar of Flame is delayed, so place it ahead of Gragas's movement. If Gragas stands beside a burning minion, pressure him with the spread from Brand E Conflagration.
Gragas.combo: Apply fire to Gragas with Brand E Conflagration, then stun him with Brand Q Sear when no minion is in its path. If starting from range, apply fire with Brand W Pillar of Flame before landing Brand Q Sear.
Gragas.escape: Right after Gragas uses Gragas E Body Slam is Brand's window to close the gap. Stun the burning Gragas with Brand Q Sear, but do not chase him too far if he retreats.
Gragas.phase: Early on, keep your distance and watch for Gragas's burst and engage. Late game, position to avoid getting picked off first. The matchup improves if you withstand Gragas's disruption.
Gragas.teamfight: Do not stand alone in the backline within range of Gragas E Body Slam. When enemies group up, apply fire with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. Watch the direction Gragas R Explosive Cask will knock you so it does not break your formation.

Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line explodes immediately when it hits terrain, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall. If caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, take the shortest route out of its area before fighting again. Basic attacks from Graves P New Destiny stop at the first unit hit, so keep a minion or ally between you and Graves.
Graves.build: Graves deals mostly physical damage, and Brand has fairly low armor, so build armor first. Sustain early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps.
Graves.fight: Counterattack or create distance right after Graves fires both basic attacks. When engaging, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration, then stun him with Brand Q Sear from an angle where minions cannot block it.
Graves.laning: Push or pressure the lane early to give Graves less room to build stacks. Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame when he steps up for a last hit, and look to spread Brand E Conflagration if he stands beside a burning minion. Brand uses a lot of mana and has low health, so leave Graves's range after poking.
Graves.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then add a stack with Brand E Conflagration. If starting up close, use Brand E Conflagration before Brand Q Sear, checking that no minion is in Brand Q Sear's path.
Graves.escape: Do not rush an engage just because Graves E Quickdraw is down; Graves can also escape with Graves R Collateral Damage. Engage when you can apply Brand P Blaze and stun him with Brand Q Sear, especially before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back up.
Graves.phase: Mid game, once Brand has built ability power, is his peak for damage. Late game, Graves grows stronger through stacks and Brand is easier to pick off first, so focus on positioning.
Graves.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, keeping minions or allies between you and Graves, and avoid positions with your back to a wall. If the enemies are grouped, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If they’re spread out, save R and keep Blaze on the frontline.

Hecarim.watch: The farther Hecarim runs with Hecarim E Devastating Charge, the greater its damage and knockback. If he turns and starts running, break his vision or move toward your allies. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear several people at once, so spread out from your allies. While Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is active, damage taken by nearby enemies heals him, so do not stay close and fight for long.
Hecarim.build: Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge deal mostly physical damage, and Brand has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to survive. Choose Plated Steelcaps for more armor. If the healing from Hecarim W Spirit of Dread becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Hecarim.fight: Keep your distance before Hecarim reaches you. Apply fire with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun him with Brand Q Sear when no minion is in its path. Use the slow from Brand R Pyroclasm and the stun from Brand Q Sear to reduce Hecarim's ability to approach and deal damage based on movement speed.
Hecarim.laning: In lane, poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block, but do not remain within Hecarim's engage range afterward. Watch your distance from allies so a knockback from Hecarim E Devastating Charge does not leave you alone.
Hecarim.combo: If responding from range, apply fire with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then add a Brand P Blaze stack with Brand E Conflagration. Against a Hecarim already in close range, Brand E Conflagration into Brand Q Sear is faster. Brand Q Sear stuns only burning targets and can be blocked by minions, so check both the fire and its path before using it.
Hecarim.escape: After you repel Hecarim’s engage, your window to go in is before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back up. Don’t chase just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down; Hecarim can escape with R Onslaught of Shadows, so check what mobility he still has. When you go in, apply Blaze first, then stun him with Brand Q Sear.
Hecarim.phase: Late game, Brand is easy to pick off first, so keep your distance in the backline and deal area damage.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows cannot catch several of you, and receive Hecarim's engage from the backline. The moment enemies group up, apply fire with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If enemies have already spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Brand P Blaze on the frontline with Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand E Conflagration.

Hwei.watch: If the root or forced movement from Hwei E Subject: Torment catches you, his follow-up abilities are easier to land. If his first ability hits you, move immediately to avoid the second ability and the passive explosion. Do not enter an area covered by Hwei Q Subject: Disaster; take a wide route around it.
Hwei.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, and Brand has fairly low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only health.
Hwei.fight: Right after Hwei uses Hwei E Subject: Torment to poke or clear the wave is your chance to fight. Apply Brand P Blaze first with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration, then stun him with Brand Q Sear from an angle minions cannot block. Do not close the gap first while Hwei E Subject: Torment is available.
Hwei.laning: Poke Hwei with Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block, when he steps forward for a last hit. Brand W Pillar of Flame detonates after a warning, so place it ahead of his movement. Leave his range after poking, and look for an all-in when Brand P Blaze is applied and Brand Q Sear is available.
Hwei.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand E Conflagration. If already close, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration first, then land Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear stuns only burning targets and stops at the first target hit, so check that it has a clear path to Hwei.
Hwei.escape: Close the gap right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used. Hwei has no mobility ability, so applying Brand P Blaze first and stunning him with Brand Q Sear lets you continue the fight. While Hwei E Subject: Torment is available, position to avoid its root or forced movement.
Hwei.phase: Brand is strongest in mid game as he builds ability power. Late game, position to avoid getting picked off first while dealing area damage.
Hwei.teamfight: From the backline, watch whether Hwei E Subject: Torment has been used. When enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then spread it with Brand E Conflagration. If enemies are spread out and Brand R Pyroclasm is unlikely to bounce between them, save it and keep Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

Heimerdinger.watch: When the landing indicator appears, move sideways to avoid its center. If it hits you, leave turret range.
Heimerdinger.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Heimerdinger deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Heimerdinger.fight: Do not repeatedly trade in front of Heimerdinger's turrets. Look for an angle on Heimerdinger himself from the side or a brush.
Heimerdinger.laning: Harass Heimerdinger when he steps forward with Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block. After one cast, do not stay in turret range. Heimerdinger's turrets shut down shortly after he moves away from them, so push him back instead of spending time destroying them one by one.
Heimerdinger.combo: From long range, apply fire with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand E Conflagration. Up close, apply fire with Brand E Conflagration first, then land Brand Q Sear. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check the projectile's path.
Heimerdinger.escape: Look for a newly placed turret or the moment just after a turret fires its empowered shot. Apply Brand P Blaze to Heimerdinger, then stun him with Brand Q Sear.
Heimerdinger.phase: Early, build magic resistance and manage your distance and turret range. Later, stay in the back so you are not caught first.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: From the back, when enemies group up, apply fire with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, do not bunch up with allies in narrow spaces near objectives. If enemies spread out and Brand R Pyroclasm is unlikely to keep bouncing, maintain Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

Ivern.watch: Ivern Q Rootcaller roots you and lets his allies dash in, so keep minions or terrain between you and Ivern before he fires it. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, reposition to avoid its repeated attacks and knockup. Standing close to a target with Ivern E Triggerseed can slow you when the shield bursts.
Ivern.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Ivern deals mostly magic damage and Brand has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Tenacity also matters when Ivern's allies can follow up on the root from Ivern Q Rootcaller or the knockup from Ivern R Daisy!.
Ivern.fight: Dodge Ivern Q Rootcaller and start trading just after he uses it. Do not stand close to a target with Ivern E Triggerseed; follow up with Brand's abilities after the shield bursts. Brand has no escape ability, so keep your distance and use Brand Q Sear when it can stun.
Ivern.laning: Harass with Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block, but do not stay within range of Ivern Q Rootcaller afterward. Do not casually walk past brush that suddenly appears from Ivern W Brushmaker. Early vision in Ivern's jungle can reveal his route when he comes to harvest camps.
Ivern.combo: From long range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun with Brand Q Sear when minions will not block the projectile. If starting up close, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration, land Brand Q Sear, then place Brand W Pillar of Flame on top. If Ivern R Daisy! is blocking the way, do not fire Brand Q Sear at an enemy behind Daisy.
Ivern.escape: Ivern Q Rootcaller is also his mobility tool, so just after he uses it is your chance to close the distance. Apply Brand P Blaze first, then stun him with Brand Q Sear to make it hard for him to escape. While Ivern Q Rootcaller is available, keep your distance: Brand can be caught and hit by follow-up attacks.
Ivern.phase: Early, use Null-Magic Mantle to endure the lane and prioritize positioning that lets you dodge Ivern Q Rootcaller. Later, stay in the back; if you are picked off first, you will struggle to deal damage.
Ivern.teamfight: From the back, when enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. When Ivern R Daisy! is blocking the way, do not throw Brand Q Sear at an enemy behind Daisy. If enemies spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and maintain Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

Janna.watch: The knockup from Janna Q Howling Gale is dangerous, so if you hear the tornado from a brush or outside vision, move out of its path. Janna R Monsoon pushes back engages and heals, so position to fight again right after she uses it. Do not unload all your damage at once into a target shielded by Janna E Eye Of The Storm.
Janna.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Janna deals mostly magic damage and Brand has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Janna R Monsoon becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Janna.fight: Bait out Janna E Eye Of The Storm, then apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration. Stun with Brand Q Sear from a position where minions will not block the projectile, then follow up with damage. Do not rush to close the distance while Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna R Monsoon are available.
Janna.laning: When the enemy marksman steps up for a last hit, harass with Brand W Pillar of Flame to make Janna use Janna E Eye Of The Storm. Back off afterward to avoid the slow from Janna W Zephyr and Janna Q Howling Gale. You can apply Brand P Blaze to a minion, then use Brand E Conflagration to pressure Janna nearby.
Janna.combo: From long range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand E Conflagration. If you apply it first with Brand E Conflagration up close, quickly follow with Brand Q Sear. Against a target shielded by Janna E Eye Of The Storm, focus your damage after the shield expires.
Janna.escape: When Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna R Monsoon are down, you have a chance to close the distance. Because Janna W Zephyr increases her movement speed, do not try to block her path with minions. Apply Brand P Blaze first, then look for a stun with Brand Q Sear.
Janna.phase: Early, use Null-Magic Mantle to endure the lane while harassing to draw out Janna E Eye Of The Storm. Later, maintain a safe position so you are not caught first, and deal area damage.
Janna.teamfight: From the back, when enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. Janna R Monsoon can push back an engage, so do not step forward to catch Janna. If enemies spread out and Brand R Pyroclasm is unlikely to keep bouncing, attack the frontline with Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand E Conflagration.

JarvanIV.build: Early, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps.
JarvanIV.combo: From long range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then land Brand Q Sear to stun when minions will not block its path.
JarvanIV.escape: If only one mobility ability is down, account for the one still available before deciding to engage.
JarvanIV.teamfight: From the back, when enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If enemies spread out and there is no target for it to bounce to, save Brand R Pyroclasm and stack Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

Karma.watch: If you stay where Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra explodes, you take additional damage, so leave the circle immediately. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, move far enough away to break it before the root. Do not chase too far while Karma E Inspire's shield and movement speed boost are active.
Karma.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Karma's magic damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Karma's healing becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon.
Karma.fight: Apply Brand P Blaze first, then look for a stun with Brand Q Sear. Keep your distance while Karma W Focused Resolve is available, and fight after avoiding or breaking the tether. Focus your damage when Karma E Inspire's shield expires.
Karma.laning: Use Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block, to harass Karma when she steps forward. Dodge Karma Q Inner Flame from behind minions or outside its range so Karma P Gathering Fire does not reduce the cooldown of Karma R Mantra. After harassing, stay outside the tether range of Karma W Focused Resolve.
Karma.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun with Brand Q Sear when no minions are in the projectile's path. If Karma is already close, apply the burn with Brand E Conflagration first, then land Brand Q Sear.
Karma.escape: Move closer after Karma W Focused Resolve has been used and Karma E Inspire's shield expires. If Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra connects, retreat far enough to break the tether before the root.
Karma.phase: Early on, avoid Karma's harass and build magic resistance first. Later, hold a safe position to avoid getting caught first while dealing area damage.
Karma.teamfight: Stay in the back and wait until Karma E Inspire's shield expires and enemies group up. Apply the burn with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If enemies are spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage when it hits you alone, so walk out when its explosion indicator appears. When needed, stand with minions or allies. Going through Karthus W Wall of Pain lowers your magic resistance and slows you, so go around it. Even after killing Karthus, move away from his body immediately to avoid spells cast during Karthus P Death Defied, and keep enough health to survive Karthus R Requiem.
Karthus.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Karthus’s damage is mainly magic, and Brand has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. It’s also important to avoid Karthus W Wall of Pain and get out of Karthus E Defile’s area quickly.
Karthus.fight: Karthus cannot create distance on his own, so trade when you can apply Brand P Blaze with a Brand ability and land Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear stuns only burning targets and is blocked by minions, so check its projectile path before using it.
Karthus.laning: While Karthus farms, lead his movement with Brand W Pillar of Flame to harass him. If you apply Brand P Blaze to a minion, look for a chance to spread it to Karthus with Brand E Conflagration. After harassing, move away instead of staying in range of Karthus Q Lay Waste or Karthus E Defile.
Karthus.combo: If Karthus is not burning, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun him with Brand Q Sear, then use Brand E Conflagration. If he is already close and not burning, start with Brand E Conflagration, land Brand Q Sear, and place Brand W Pillar of Flame where he is stunned. Before casting Brand Q Sear, check that no minion will block the projectile.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no ability to create distance on his own, so move in when you can apply Brand P Blaze and land Brand Q Sear. If Karthus W Wall of Pain appears, take a route around it instead of going through it. If you kill Karthus, immediately leave his body while Karthus P Death Defied is active.
Karthus.phase: Later, Brand is easily caught first, so fight from a safe position in the back.
Karthus.teamfight: When enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze from the back with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If enemies are spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Brand P Blaze on the frontline. After killing Karthus, reposition immediately to avoid Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus E Defile cast during Karthus P Death Defied.

Jax.watch: Jax Q Leap Strike can use minions to close the gap, so do not stand close to a minion wave. When Jax E Counter Strike activates, stop basic attacking and retreat outside its area stun range.
Jax.build: The material gives no first purchase item, so a purchase order cannot be set. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so avoid building only one type of resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on maximum health, so also be cautious about building only a large amount of health.
Jax.fight: Take short trades instead of fighting long enough for Jax P Relentless Assault to stack. Once Jax Q Leap Strike and Jax E Counter Strike have been used, apply Brand P Blaze first and look for a stun with Brand Q Sear.
Jax.laning: Watch the positions of allied minions that Jax could use for Jax Q Leap Strike, and stand away from the wave. Instead of using a response ability as soon as Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike, pressure him after it ends.
Jax.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun with Brand Q Sear when no minions are in the projectile's path. If Jax is already close, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration, then follow with Brand Q Sear.
Jax.escape: Right after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike, his movement ability is unavailable; control your distance and look for a stun with Brand Q Sear. If Jax E Counter Strike has also ended, you can follow up with abilities without worrying about basic attack negation or its area stun. Before using Brand Q Sear, apply Brand P Blaze and check that no minion will block the projectile.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps in with Jax E Counter Strike active, spread out from your allies and leave its area stun range. After the stun ends, apply Brand P Blaze and lock Jax down with Brand Q Sear. When enemies group up, use Brand W Pillar of Flame, Brand E Conflagration, then Brand R Pyroclasm from the back to stack area damage.

Kayn.watch: Dodge the straight-line hit of Kayn W Blade's Reach to prevent it from leading into a long-range engage with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. If Kayn approaches through a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, watch for the warning indicator at the wall's edge and retreat toward your turret.
Kayn.build: Kayn's main damage is physical and Brand has low armor, so buy Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps. If the healing of Kayn after transforming into Rhaast becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon after building armor.
Kayn.fight: Dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach and fight before Kayn R Umbral Trespass is available again. First apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration or Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun with Brand Q Sear when no minions are in the projectile's path.
Kayn.laning: Harass enemies coming forward to last-hit with Brand W Pillar of Flame, but do not stay in range after using it. If the indicator for Kayn E Shadow Step appears at a wall's edge, stop trading and retreat toward your turret.
Kayn.combo: Against Kayn up close, use Brand E Conflagration → Brand Q Sear → Brand W Pillar of Flame. If starting from range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then deal follow-up damage where he is stunned.
Kayn.escape: Do not rush in just because Kayn Q Reaping Slash has been used; Kayn can still escape with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Your opportunity is before Kayn R Umbral Trespass is available again, when you can land Brand Q Sear on a Kayn affected by Brand P Blaze.
Kayn.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming, so early on, avoid giving up kills while pressuring his jungle path and objectives to delay his transformation. Later, focus on positioning because you are easily caught first.
Kayn.teamfight: When enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze from the back with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If Kayn R Umbral Trespass enters an ally, prepare crowd control around that ally and interrupt Kayn with Brand Q Sear as he emerges.

Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage to isolated targets, so stay near allies or minions. Be ready to use Brand Q Sear when Kha'Zix jumps in with Kha'Zix E Leap. If he vanishes with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, place Brand W Pillar of Flame along his expected approach.
Khazix.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Kha'Zix deals mostly physical damage, so build armor early. Add Morellonomicon if the healing from Kha'Zix W Void Spike becomes a problem.
Khazix.fight: Fight near allies or minions to avoid the isolation damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Right after Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap to engage, apply Blaze with Brand E Conflagration and counterattack by stunning him with Brand Q Sear.
Khazix.laning: Stay near minions and poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame. After using it, stay outside Kha'Zix's engage range. Prioritize vision in the river and jungle entrance brushes to watch for his basic attack empowered by Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat.
Khazix.combo: When Kha'Zix enters Brand E Conflagration range, use it to apply Blaze, stun him with Brand Q Sear, and place Brand W Pillar of Flame on his position. If you can hit him first from farther away, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame before using Brand Q Sear, but check that no minions block its path.
Khazix.escape: Kha'Zix E Leap is your opening to counterattack right after he uses it to engage. Save Brand Q Sear and Flash for this moment, but apply Blaze first when looking for a Q stun. If an ally is caught, Kha'Zix E Leap's cooldown may reset, so watch for a chase.
Khazix.phase: Brand deals strong damage in mid game, but stop moving alone once Kha'Zix has two or more evolutions. In late game, position near allies to avoid getting picked off first.
Khazix.teamfight: Stand close to allies in a warded choke point to prevent isolation, and fight from the back. When enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm.

Kindred.watch: If Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied to you, create distance or break line of sight to avoid taking consecutive hits. Its damage scales with missing health, making it especially dangerous when you are low. Inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, Kindred can keep moving with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows, so do not force a Brand W Pillar of Flame hit there.
Kindred.build: Kindred deals mostly physical damage, so buy Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps. Add Morellonomicon if the healing from Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb's Respite becomes a problem.
Kindred.fight: Take a fight after Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy ends, when you can hit a Kindred affected by Blaze with Brand Q Sear. If Kindred E Mounting Dread is on you and your health has dropped, disengage instead of continuing the fight.
Kindred.laning: Poke Kindred with Brand W Pillar of Flame when she steps forward to last-hit, then stay outside her range. If a minion is affected by Blaze, Brand E Conflagration can spread it to Kindred beside that minion. When a Kindred mark appears on a jungle monster, take the camp first or establish nearby vision to delay her from claiming the mark.
Kindred.combo: At range, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun Kindred with Brand Q Sear when no minions block its path. If she is already affected by Blaze and close to you, Brand E Conflagration into Brand Q Sear is faster.
Kindred.escape: Do not engage just because Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down. Look for a moment before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is available again when you can hit a Kindred affected by Blaze with Brand Q Sear.
Kindred.phase: Kindred is vulnerable to pressure early, so slow her growth by controlling vision and contesting marks. In late game, position in the back to avoid getting picked off first and deal area damage.
Kindred.teamfight: From the back, when enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If Kindred activates Kindred R Lamb's Respite, survive inside its area with low-health allies and account for the heal when it ends. If enemies are spread out and Brand R Pyroclasm is unlikely to keep bouncing, save it and maintain Blaze on the front line.

Lillia.watch: Dodge Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed even at high health, since being hit can make you a target for the sleep from Lillia R Lilting Lullaby. When you see Lillia start casting Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, move sideways to avoid its center.
Lillia.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lillia deals mostly magic damage and Brand has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance early. Add Morellonomicon if the healing from Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough becomes a problem.
Lillia.fight: Look for a moment when Lillia has repeatedly missed her abilities and has no movement speed stacks. Apply Blaze first, then stun her with Brand Q Sear along a path clear of minions and place Brand W Pillar of Flame on her while she is stunned.
Lillia.laning: Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame, placing it ahead of Lillia's movement because it detonates after a delay. Stay outside her range after poking. When you do not know where Lillia is, avoid narrow passages where Lillia E Swirlseed is hard to dodge.
Lillia.combo: From afar, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun Lillia with Brand Q Sear. If the fight starts up close, apply Blaze first with Brand E Conflagration, follow with Brand Q Sear, and hit the stunned Lillia with Brand W Pillar of Flame.
Lillia.escape: Right after you make Lillia use Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is your chance to close the distance and catch her. When Lillia is affected by Blaze and no minions block the projectile, hit her with Brand Q Sear to stun her.
Lillia.phase: Mid game, as ability power builds up, is Brand's damage peak. In late game, hold a backline position to avoid getting picked off first.
Lillia.teamfight: When enemies group up, apply Blaze from the back with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If they spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and maintain Blaze on the front line.

Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade passes through targets and pulls her to the last champion hit, so do not stand in a straight line with your allied marksman. When Leona W Eclipse activates, leave its area before it detonates. When the indicator for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the central stun. Leona may activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak before approaching, so do not let her get close.
Leona.build: Use Null-Magic Mantle to survive early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Brand has relatively low magic resistance and Leona deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Afterward, choose resistances based on the damage type of the enemy damage dealer who attacks while Leona holds you in place.
Leona.fight: While Leona E Zenith Blade is available, keep your distance and poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame. Once Leona E Zenith Blade is down, hit a Leona affected by Blaze with Brand Q Sear to stun her and counterattack.
Leona.laning: Leona has high armor early, so wear down her health with Brand W Pillar of Flame from outside her range and trade after she uses her engage ability. After using Brand W Pillar of Flame, stay outside her engage range and avoid standing in a straight line with your allied marksman.
Leona.combo: When starting from afar, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun Leona with Brand Q Sear if no minions block the projectile. If Leona is already close, apply Blaze first with Brand E Conflagration and follow with Brand Q Sear. If Leona W Eclipse is active, leave its detonation area and reestablish distance.
Leona.escape: Right after Leona E Zenith Blade is used is Brand's chance to close the distance and counterattack. Even then, attempt the stun with Brand Q Sear only when Leona is affected by Blaze and the projectile path is clear. If Leona still has an ability that can lock you down, keep your distance because Brand has no escape ability.
Leona.phase: Early, respect Leona's high armor and engage, and wear down her health from range. In late game, maintain a position where you will not be caught first and deal area damage.
Leona.teamfight: From the back, when enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If enemies have already spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and maintain Blaze on the front line with Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand E Conflagration. If Leona P Sunlight marks you, retreat immediately: it signals an incoming follow-up attack.

Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy prevents you from using abilities and attacks, so after applying Blaze, check whether Lulu W Whimsy is available before using Brand Q Sear. Lulu R Wild Growth saves its target and knocks up nearby enemies, so stay away from that target while Lulu R Wild Growth is available.
Lulu.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, then choose Mercury's Treads. Lulu deals mostly magic damage, and Brand has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lulu.fight: Lulu is strong against burst damage, so poke her steadily with Brand W Pillar of Flame. When Blaze is on Lulu and you have a clear shot for Brand Q Sear, stun her and continue the trade.
Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion. When she steps forward to last-hit, poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block, then back away.
Lulu.combo: Apply Blaze to Lulu first with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration, then stun her with Brand Q Sear. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check its path, and place Brand W Pillar of Flame where she is stunned.
Lulu.escape: After Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally, Brand has a chance to close the gap. If Lulu E Help, Pix! is shielding an allied carry, target Lulu herself: apply Blaze first, then stun her with Brand Q Sear.
Lulu.phase: Early on, keep your distance, survive with magic resistance, and focus on poking with Brand W Pillar of Flame. Later, hold a safe position so you are not caught first, and deal area damage.
Lulu.teamfight: From the backline, when enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, spread Blaze among grouped enemies instead of focusing all your damage on one target she can protect. If enemies are spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and hit the frontline with Brand E Conflagration and Brand W Pillar of Flame.

LeeSin.watch: If the first hit of Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike lands, he can follow with a dash and damage based on your missing health, so keep the minion wave between you and him when you expect a gank. If you have been hit by the first strike and fall below half health, move toward your turret or team while the second strike is available. Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will lets him cross walls, so stay away from walls without vision. Before a teamfight, watch which direction Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage could knock you and leave some space between you and your allies.
LeeSin.build: Lee Sin deals mostly physical damage, and Brand has low armor, so build armor first. Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps.
LeeSin.fight: Trade when Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or before it comes back up. Apply Brand P Blaze first, stun him with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand E Conflagration before Lee Sin can close in again. Do not initiate an all-in if Blaze is not applied or Brand Q Sear is unavailable.
LeeSin.laning: If you expect a gank, keep the wave between you and Lee Sin to block the straight angle for Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike. Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame, but it costs a lot of mana and Brand has low health, so don't stay within range after using it. If you have applied Blaze to a minion, take advantage of Brand E Conflagration spreading to nearby targets. Use Brand Q Sear on Lee Sin only when Blaze is already applied to him and no minions are in the projectile's path.
LeeSin.combo: If Lee Sin gets close, set him ablaze with Brand E Conflagration, stun him with Brand Q Sear, then place Brand W Pillar of Flame on him. At a distance, apply the fire first with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then follow with Brand Q Sear and Brand E Conflagration. In a fight where several enemies are grouped, spread Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame followed by Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm.
LeeSin.escape: Go in when Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or before it comes back up. If he has also just used Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will to engage, set him ablaze with Brand E Conflagration, stun him with Brand Q Sear, and focus your damage. If he has used only one mobility ability, do not chase too far; he can escape with the other.
LeeSin.phase: If you meet Lee Sin in the jungle early, retreat instead of taking the duel. Lee Sin becomes weaker later, but Brand is also easy to pick off first, so buy time through objectives and lane advantages while keeping a safe position.
LeeSin.teamfight: From the backline, when enemies group up, Brand applies the fire with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spreads it with Brand E Conflagration, then uses Brand R Pyroclasm. If they have already spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Blaze on the frontline. Leave space between you and your allies so Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage cannot kick you into them, and watch for room Lee Sin could use to get behind you.

Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, her follow-up abilities are likely to hit too, so do not line up with an ally before Lux uses Q. Move out of Lux E Lucent Singularity, and dodge sideways when the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark appears. If one of Lux's abilities hits you, retreat beyond her attack range so she cannot trigger the Lux P Illumination mark with an attack.
Lux.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Lux's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads and build magic resistance first.
Lux.fight: Bait out Lux Q Light Binding and dodge it, then close the distance. Apply Blaze to Lux and stun her with Brand Q Sear; you can follow up with damage while she can't escape with her mobility spell.
Lux.laning: Poke Lux as she steps forward with Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so use it when Blaze is on Lux and the projectile has a clear path. After poking, do not stay within Lux's ability range.
Lux.combo: From a distance, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun Lux with Brand Q Sear, then add a stack with Brand E Conflagration. If she gets close, apply Blaze first with Brand E Conflagration, then land Brand Q Sear. If Lux stands near minions, you can also use Brand E Conflagration on a burning minion to spread Blaze.
Lux.escape: Right after Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to close the gap. Lux has no mobility ability, so once you reach her, stun her with Brand Q Sear while Blaze is on her.
Lux.phase: Brand is strongest in the mid game as he builds ability power. Later, position so you are not picked off first and deal damage from the backline.
Lux.teamfight: Do not approach grouped with your allies where Lux E Lucent Singularity can catch you together. From the backline, when enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If they have already spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Blaze on the frontline.

Maokai.watch: If Maokai W Twisted Advance catches Brand, Brand has no ability to escape on his own and is likely to take follow-up damage. While Maokai W Twisted Advance is available, stay out of its range near brush and watch for Maokai E Sapling Toss planted in brush. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp comes from far away, dodge perpendicular to its path and take fights in open areas with room to evade it.
Maokai.build: Early on, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Maokai deals mostly magic damage, and Brand has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Maokai P Sap Magic becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon to your build.
Maokai.fight: Keep your distance while Maokai W Twisted Advance is available, then trade right after he uses it. Repeatedly hitting Maokai with abilities brings back the healing from Maokai P Sap Magic faster, so prioritize poking the enemy carries in ordinary trades.
Maokai.laning: Poke the enemy carry with Brand W Pillar of Flame as they step forward to last-hit, then immediately back away. If Maokai W Twisted Advance is available, do not move close to brush. If a sapling from Maokai E Sapling Toss follows you, lead it toward minions or monsters, not your allies.
Maokai.combo: After Maokai W Twisted Advance is used, set him ablaze first with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun him with Brand Q Sear, then use Brand E Conflagration. At close range, apply the fire with Brand E Conflagration, then land Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear stuns only a burning target and is blocked by minions, so check that Blaze is applied and the projectile path is clear.
Maokai.escape: Right after you force Maokai W Twisted Advance is Brand's chance to move forward. Apply Blaze first, then stun him with Brand Q Sear, but if Maokai R Nature's Grasp is available, leave enough room to dodge its root.
Maokai.phase: Early on, watch for Maokai's roots and survive with Null-Magic Mantle. Later, hold a safe position while fighting, because you will struggle to deal damage if caught first.
Maokai.teamfight: Stay in the backline with room to dodge Maokai R Nature's Grasp, and do not move forward to hit the frontline. When enemies group up, apply the fire with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If they spread out and Brand R Pyroclasm is unlikely to bounce, save it and keep Blaze on the frontline with Brand E Conflagration and Brand W Pillar of Flame.

Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first enemy it hits, so wait until he uses it before closing in on him. While Milio W Cozy Campfire extends the enemy marksman’s range, delay frontline fights.
Milio.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to withstand the lane and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Milio deals magic damage, but not much of it, so choose later resistances based on the enemy carry’s damage type. Add Morellonomicon if the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life becomes a problem.
Milio.fight: Trade when you can apply Brand P Blaze first and stun with Brand Q Sear. If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, you have a chance to close in, but Brand has no mobility and low health, so do not stay within enemy range after using your spells.
Milio.laning: Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame when the enemy marksman steps up to last hit; minions cannot block it. If Milio stands beside a burning minion, you can spread Brand E Conflagration to him. Pressure their mana through repeated trades and take control of the wave before Milio’s team composition grows stronger.
Milio.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun with Brand Q Sear when no minion is in its path. If you are close to an already burning Milio, quickly use Brand E Conflagration followed by Brand Q Sear.
Milio.escape: After Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, you have a chance to close in on him. Apply Brand P Blaze first, then stun with Brand Q Sear from an angle where minions cannot block it.
Milio.phase: Early on, pressure Milio’s team composition with poke and wave control before it grows stronger over time. Later, position so you are not caught first.
Milio.teamfight: Stay in the back and wait for enemies to group up. Apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. While Milio W Cozy Campfire extends the enemy marksman’s range, delay frontline fights. If enemies spread out and Brand R Pyroclasm is unlikely to bounce, save it and maintain Brand P Blaze on the frontline with Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand E Conflagration.

MasterYi.watch: Master Yi cannot be targeted during Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so save Brand E Conflagration until he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, the slow from Brand R Pyroclasm does not work on him. Basic attacks empowered by Master Yi E Wuju Style include true damage, so do not rely on armor alone when fighting him.
MasterYi.build: Master Yi deals mostly physical damage, and Brand has low armor, so buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps. Armor cannot reduce the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, so build health too. Add Morellonomicon if healing from Master Yi W Meditate becomes a problem.
MasterYi.fight: Look for the moment just after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends and he lands. Apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration or Brand W Pillar of Flame first, then stun with Brand Q Sear from a path clear of minions. If Master Yi activates Master Yi W Meditate, interrupt its channel with Brand Q Sear if you saved it.
MasterYi.laning: Poke enemies stepping up to last hit with Brand W Pillar of Flame, but it costs a lot of mana, so back away after using it. Master Yi is weak in the jungle early and has limited gank potential, so do not delay taking early objectives.
MasterYi.combo: Wait for Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to land, then use Brand E Conflagration → Brand Q Sear → Brand W Pillar of Flame. Brand E Conflagration must apply Brand P Blaze first for Brand Q Sear to stun; place the delayed Brand W Pillar of Flame where he is stunned.
MasterYi.escape: Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is a mobility tool, so immediately after he uses it is Brand’s chance to close in or catch him. Apply Brand P Blaze to Master Yi when he lands, then stun him with Brand Q Sear. If Brand Q Sear is unavailable, do not approach Master Yi while Master Yi R Highlander is active relying only on a slow.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi is weak in the jungle early, so take early objectives to slow his growth. He grows stronger as the game goes on, so position Brand to avoid being caught first later.
MasterYi.teamfight: Stay in the back. When enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If Master Yi engages with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, stop him with the stun from Brand Q Sear just after he lands, and respond together so he cannot kill an isolated ally. If enemies have already spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and maintain Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is a targeted dash, so you cannot dodge it once you are in range. If Wukong Q Crushing Blow hits after he closes in, it reduces your armor. The clone left by Wukong W Warrior Trickster stays in place, so watch which way the real Wukong moves before using spells on the clone.
MonkeyKing.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor to withstand Wukong’s physical damage and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against his main damage, but remember that armor does not block the magic damage from Wukong E Nimbus Strike. Add Morellonomicon if healing from Wukong P Stone Skin becomes a problem.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong has relatively low magic resistance, so if he closes in, fight back by applying Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration and looking for a stun with Brand Q Sear. Wukong P Stone Skin builds armor and regeneration the longer a fight lasts, so deal damage briefly and back away. Brand Q Sear cannot stun a target without Brand P Blaze, so do not cast it first.
MonkeyKing.laning: Minions cannot block Brand W Pillar of Flame, so place it ahead of Wukong’s movement to poke him as he steps forward. Using Brand E Conflagration on a burning minion increases its spread range and can reach a nearby Wukong. After poking, do not stay within range of Wukong E Nimbus Strike.
MonkeyKing.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun with Brand Q Sear. If Wukong is already close, use Brand E Conflagration → Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear stops at the first enemy hit, so make sure no minion is in its path to the real Wukong. If Wukong W Warrior Trickster creates a clone, do not use your combo on the clone standing still; watch where the real Wukong moves.
MonkeyKing.escape: The window after Wukong W Warrior Trickster is used and before it comes back is a chance to engage. Check whether Wukong E Nimbus Strike is still available, then apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration and stun with Brand Q Sear. Just after Wukong R Cyclone is used is another chance to force a fight.
MonkeyKing.phase: Brand is strongest in the mid game as his ability power builds up. Later, Brand is easy to catch first, so hold your position while fighting.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: While Wukong R Cyclone is available, keep your distance from allies and watch for Wukong’s engage from the backline. If enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If enemies spread out and Brand R Pyroclasm is unlikely to bounce, save it and maintain Brand P Blaze on the frontline with Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand E Conflagration.

Morgana.watch: Morgana Q Dark Binding catches only the first target it hits, so keep minions between you and her to avoid it. If Morgana R Soul Shackles links to you, leave its range before the stun triggers.
Morgana.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Morgana’s magic damage and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Add Morellonomicon if healing from Morgana P Soul Siphon and Morgana W Tormented Shadow becomes a problem.
Morgana.fight: Brand has no ability to escape on his own, so first keep enough distance to avoid Morgana Q Dark Binding. When Morgana E Black Shield is down and the enemy has Brand P Blaze, look for a stun with Brand Q Sear. Check that no minion is in its path.
Morgana.laning: Keep minions between you and Morgana to avoid Morgana Q Dark Binding, and place Brand W Pillar of Flame on enemies stepping forward to last hit. Place Brand W Pillar of Flame ahead of their movement, then avoid staying within Morgana’s binding range after poking.
Morgana.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand E Conflagration. Up close, apply Brand P Blaze first with Brand E Conflagration, then hit Brand Q Sear. If Morgana E Black Shield is active, do not waste the stun from Brand Q Sear.
Morgana.escape: After you dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana E Black Shield is down, you have a chance to start a fight. Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so close in, apply Brand P Blaze, and stun her with Brand Q Sear.
Morgana.phase: Early on, avoid Morgana Q Dark Binding and build magic resistance first. Later, focus on positioning: if you are caught first, you will be unable to act.
Morgana.teamfight: Stay in the back, watch for Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana R Soul Shackles, and wait for enemies to group up. Apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If enemies have already spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and maintain Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison falls slowly, so sidestep when you see it coming. Sidestep Nami R Tidal Wave as soon as it appears, too. Either hit can leave you vulnerable to Nami's follow-up, so keep your distance.
Nami.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Nami's magic damage and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Nami W Ebb and Flow's healing becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon. Brand P Blaze's damage over time can keep Grievous Wounds applied longer.
Nami.fight: Trade right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. Apply Brand P Blaze to Nami first, then stun her with Brand Q Sear from an angle where minions cannot block it. Avoid a direct fight with an opponent affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing; look for another chance after it expires.
Nami.laning: Nami has low health and no mobility skill, so establish vision and focus your poke on her. When she steps up to last-hit, poke her with Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block. Afterward, back away to avoid a Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave combo.
Nami.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then look for a stun with Brand Q Sear. If Nami is already close, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration first, then use Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear only stuns a burning target, so check that no minions are in its path.
