Nami.escape: Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to pressure her. Nami has no mobility skill, but Brand has no escape skill either. Sidestep when you see Nami R Tidal Wave coming, and do not move in too aggressively.
Nami.phase: Early on, build magic resistance and survive by avoiding Nami's crowd control. Later, focus on positioning: if you get caught first, you cannot deal damage.
Nami.teamfight: Stay in the back. When enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If they are spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Brand P Blaze applied to the frontline. Do not move forward into a Nami R Tidal Wave and Nami Q Aqua Prison combo.

Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engage and follow-up crowd control, so keep minions between you and him to avoid it. The first basic attack from Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots you, so do not stay within basic attack range after trading. When Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, do not stand close to allies along its path.
Nautilus.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to withstand his damage and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nautilus deals mostly magic damage, and Brand's magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first.
Nautilus.fight: Close the distance and trade right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses. Apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration first, then stun him with Brand Q Sear along a path minions cannot block. Back away before a basic attack from Nautilus P Staggering Blow hits you.
Nautilus.laning: Keep minions between you and Nautilus to block Nautilus Q Dredge Line while poking with Brand W Pillar of Flame. When an opponent steps up to last-hit, place Brand W Pillar of Flame ahead of their movement, then move out of Nautilus's engage range. Applying Brand P Blaze to a minion can let Brand E Conflagration spread to an opponent beside it.
Nautilus.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun with Brand Q Sear. If Nautilus is close, use Brand E Conflagration before Brand Q Sear.
Nautilus.escape: Bait out Nautilus Q Dredge Line. If it misses, move in and look for a stun with Brand Q Sear. Apply Brand P Blaze first with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration. Keep your distance if moving in would put you in range of the root from Nautilus P Staggering Blow or the crowd control from Nautilus R Depth Charge.
Nautilus.phase: Early on, Brand is vulnerable to follow-up abilities once caught, so managing distance comes first. Later, position to avoid getting picked off first and deal damage from the back.
Nautilus.teamfight: Stay in the back and avoid standing close to allies along the path of Nautilus R Depth Charge. When enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If they are too spread out for Brand R Pyroclasm to chain reliably, save it and keep Brand P Blaze applied to the frontline with Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand E Conflagration.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and faster after hitting something first, so do not stand close to allies. Leave the area when you see Neeko R Pop Blossom winding up. If a disguised Neeko approaches, spread out before the windup appears. Do not chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter.
Neeko.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Neeko's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If getting rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs lets Neeko R Pop Blossom hit you as well, prioritize tenacity.
Neeko.fight: Apply Brand P Blaze first, then stun with Brand Q Sear, checking that no minions are in its path. Brand has no escape skill, so keep your distance while Neeko's root and engage are available.
Neeko.laning: Poke Neeko as she steps forward with Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block. If she stands beside minions, apply Brand P Blaze to a minion, then spread damage with Brand E Conflagration. After poking, do not stay within range of Neeko E Tangle-Barbs.
Neeko.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then follow up with Brand E Conflagration. If Neeko is already close, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration first, then use Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear only stuns a burning target, so do not cast it first.
Neeko.escape: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used is your chance to fight without getting rooted by it. If Neeko W Shapesplitter creates a clone, do not chase it; watch the real Neeko's position.
Neeko.phase: Mid game, as you build ability power, Brand's damage is at its peak. Late game, hold a safe position to avoid getting caught first while dealing area damage.
Neeko.teamfight: Stay in the back and spread out from allies so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs cannot root several of you at once. Watch for Neeko approaching in disguise, and spread out early if you suspect an engage with Neeko R Pop Blossom. When enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm.

Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss hurts more the farther it travels, so take particular care to dodge it when Nidalee is far away, and keep minions or your allied frontline between you and her. Avoid Nidalee W Bushwhack so you do not become Hunted. If Nidalee uses Nidalee W Pounce to jump in after you become Hunted, Nidalee Q Takedown follows, so be ready to use Brand Q Sear.
Nidalee.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nidalee deals mostly magic damage, and Brand's magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Nidalee E Primal Surge becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon.
Nidalee.fight: When Nidalee has Brand P Blaze on her and you can land Brand Q Sear, stun her and follow up with damage. Right after you bait out Nidalee W Pounce, look for another chance to catch her with Brand Q Sear.
Nidalee.laning: Poke Nidalee as she steps forward with Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block. After using it, back away to avoid exposure to Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and Nidalee W Pounce. Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack at jungle entrances and along the river; clear traps with a Control Ward or area ability before entering.
Nidalee.combo: If starting from range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then follow up with Brand E Conflagration. If Nidalee jumps in close with Nidalee W Pounce, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration first, then land Brand Q Sear. Use Brand Q Sear when no minions are in its path.
Nidalee.escape: Nidalee has no crowd control, so right after Nidalee W Pounce is used is your chance to close the distance and catch her. Apply Brand P Blaze first, then stun with Brand Q Sear so she cannot escape with Nidalee W Pounce.
Nidalee.phase: Mid game, as you build ability power, Brand's damage is at its peak. Late game, position to avoid getting picked off first and deal area damage.
Nidalee.teamfight: Stay in the back. When enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. Remember where Nidalee stood to throw her spear, and stun her with Brand Q Sear when you can catch her. If enemies have already spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Brand P Blaze applied to the frontline.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns you, so stay out of its range. When Pantheon uses Q Comet Spear to poke, keep minions between you. If you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.
Pantheon.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pantheon's main damage is physical, and Brand has low armor, so build armor first.
Pantheon.fight: When Pantheon has Brand P Blaze on him and Brand Q Sear is ready, land the stun from an angle where minions cannot block it, then follow up with damage.
Pantheon.laning: Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame from outside Pantheon W Shield Vault range. Keep minions between you when Pantheon Q Comet Spear could hit you, and do not remain within Pantheon's engage range after using Brand W Pillar of Flame.
Pantheon.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun with Brand Q Sear. If Pantheon is already close and has no Brand P Blaze on him, apply it with Brand E Conflagration, then land Brand Q Sear. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault is facing you, hold your damage abilities until it ends or use them from the side.
Pantheon.escape: The window to attack is after Pantheon W Shield Vault has been used and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available again. Even then, apply Brand P Blaze first to set up the stun from Brand Q Sear before going in.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's impact falls off late, but Brand is also easy to catch first, so maintain your position while fighting.
Pantheon.teamfight: Stay in the back and wait for enemies to group up. Apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is facing you, wait for it to end or attack from the side. If enemies are spread out and Brand R Pyroclasm is unlikely to bounce, save it and keep Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from long range and knocks you up. When you see it, sidestep toward the side the snowball is coming from and move into the space Nunu passed through instead of only running backward. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, leave immediately before the delayed root. The slow grows stronger inside Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero. If the target already has Brand P Blaze and Brand Q Sear has a clear path, use it to interrupt the channel; otherwise, leave the area.
Nunu.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nunu & Willump deals mostly magic damage and has several ways to lock you down, so magic resistance and tenacity are useful. If the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Nunu.fight: Keep your distance and apply Brand P Blaze first with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration. When minions will not block the projectile, stun with Brand Q Sear. Using Brand Q Sear first on a target without Brand P Blaze will not stun.
Nunu.laning: Keep in mind that Nunu & Willump can return immediately after a gank. Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block, then return to a safe distance right away.
Nunu.combo: If starting from range, apply Brand P Blaze first with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then land Brand Q Sear. When several enemies group up, use Brand W Pillar of Flame → Brand E Conflagration to spread Brand P Blaze, then use Brand R Pyroclasm.
Nunu.escape: Look for a fight after dodging the engage from Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and getting clear of the root threat from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage. If Nunu & Willump has Brand P Blaze and Brand Q Sear has a clear path, stun them and follow up with Brand W Pillar of Flame.
Nunu.phase: Late game, stay in the back so Brand is not caught and killed first.
Nunu.teamfight: From the back, when enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, interrupt it with the stun from Brand Q Sear if its conditions are met; if you cannot interrupt it, leave the area. If enemies are spread out and Brand R Pyroclasm is unlikely to bounce, save it and build stacks of Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

Poppy.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Poppy's main damage is physical, and Brand has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Poppy.fight: Brand has no escape ability, so dodge or bait out Poppy E Heroic Charge, then fight while managing your distance. Apply Brand P Blaze to Poppy first, stun her with Brand Q Sear from a line minions cannot block, then land Brand W Pillar of Flame.
Poppy.laning: Stand in open space away from walls so Poppy E Heroic Charge cannot stun you. Minions cannot block Brand W Pillar of Flame, so place it ahead of Poppy's path as she moves forward, then create distance after poking. If Poppy's thrown shield lands on the ground, step on it to deny her the shield.
Poppy.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze first with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand E Conflagration. If Poppy is already close, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration, then land Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear stuns only targets with Brand P Blaze and stops at the first enemy hit, so check whether a minion blocks its path before casting.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you bait out Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the distance and fight. Apply Brand P Blaze to Poppy and stun her with Brand Q Sear to make it hard for her to get away.
Poppy.phase: Early on, a single hit from Poppy E Heroic Charge makes it easy for her to land follow-up damage, so manage your distance and position relative to walls first. Late game, getting caught first makes it hard to contribute, so maintain your position while fighting.

Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls Brand in, his lack of mobility makes the follow-up attacks hard to avoid. When Pyke E Phantom Undertow starts, move to the side of its dash path to avoid the stun. If you see a shark shadow beneath you, Pyke W Ghostwater Dive has already brought him close, so retreat toward allies or your turret.
Pyke.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pyke deals mostly physical damage, so build armor before magic resistance. Account for Pyke's armor penetration and the execution threshold of Pyke R Death From Below by building health, and fit in Morellonomicon if his healing becomes a problem.
Pyke.fight: Start a trade when Pyke has Brand P Blaze on him and you can land Brand Q Sear. If you sidestep Pyke E Phantom Undertow, target where he ends up, but check whether Pyke R Death From Below is still available. After stunning him, create distance again so Pyke Q Bone Skewer cannot catch you.
Pyke.laning: Use Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block, to poke as Pyke steps forward. You can also apply Brand P Blaze to a minion and spread it to nearby Pyke with Brand E Conflagration. Do not stay within Pyke's range after poking, and keep vision on him after a trade to prevent healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Pyke.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze to Pyke first with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun him with Brand Q Sear when no minions are in the projectile's path. If Pyke is already close, aim for a stun with Brand E Conflagration → Brand Q Sear. Using Brand Q Sear first will not trigger the stun from Brand P Blaze.
Pyke.escape: The moment after dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow is an opportunity, but do not commit too far if Pyke R Death From Below is still available. Before Pyke R Death From Below is available again, apply Brand P Blaze to Pyke, stun him with Brand Q Sear, and attack.
Pyke.phase: Mid game, as ability power builds up, is Brand's damage peak. Late game, getting caught first leaves you unable to do anything, so hold your position behind the frontline.
Pyke.teamfight: Do not stand on top of a low-health ally, reducing the risk of Pyke R Death From Below chaining executions. From the back, when enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If enemies are spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, keep minions between you and him and stay outside Rammus E Frenzying Taunt range. Rammus R Soaring Slam covers a larger area the faster he rolls, so retreat well clear and leave the landing area immediately.
Rammus.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first for magic resistance. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rammus deals primarily magic damage, and Brand has trouble escaping once caught by crowd control.
Rammus.fight: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, keep your distance instead of committing damage. Once it ends, apply Brand P Blaze, stun him with Brand Q Sear, and follow up with damage. Do not step into Rammus E Frenzying Taunt range first.
Rammus.laning: Keep a minion wave between you and Rammus to block his Rammus Q Powerball approach, and poke with the long range of Brand W Pillar of Flame. Place Brand W Pillar of Flame ahead of his movement, then stay out of his reach.
Rammus.combo: From a distance, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun with Brand Q Sear. If he is already close, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration before using Brand Q Sear. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check the projectile's path.
Rammus.escape: The window after Rammus R Soaring Slam is used is your chance to attack. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is also down, apply Brand P Blaze first, stun with Brand Q Sear, and follow up with damage. If you are taunted, plan your movement for the moment it ends.
Rammus.phase: Early on, build magic resistance and watch for Rammus's approach. Later, stay in the back so you are not caught first.
Rammus.teamfight: From the back, avoid the landing area of Rammus R Soaring Slam and focus damage after Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends. If enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If they spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance knocks you up at its landing point after the dash, so sidestep when Rakan starts moving. When Rakan R The Quickness activates, create distance before he reaches you and avoid lining up with your allies.
Rakan.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rakan deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Rakan.fight: Look for the moment just after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers breaks. Continue trading when Brand P Blaze is on Rakan and you can land Brand Q Sear.
Rakan.laning: Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame, but after using it, do not stay within Rakan W Grand Entrance range. Look for moments when Rakan moves alone, since he cannot use Rakan E Battle Dance on an ally then.
Rakan.combo: From a distance, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame first, then stun with Brand Q Sear. If he is already close, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration, land Brand Q Sear, then place Brand W Pillar of Flame on him. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check its projectile path.
Rakan.escape: The moment after Rakan W Grand Entrance misses is a window to close the distance. If Brand P Blaze is on Rakan and the projectile path is clear, counterattack by stunning him with Brand Q Sear.
Rakan.phase: Early on, watch for Rakan's engage and keep your distance. Later, focus on positioning so you are not caught first.
Rakan.teamfight: From the back, watch Rakan's engage, avoid his landing point, and look for a chance to land Brand Q Sear while Brand P Blaze is on him. If enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If they spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

RekSai.watch: If Rek'Sai knocks you up when she emerges with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Unburrow, her follow-up attacks are hard to avoid. When she burrows, move toward open ground away from walls and narrow paths. If Rek'Sai has damaged you recently, move close to your allies in case she uses Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
RekSai.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. Rek'Sai deals primarily physical damage, so build armor first. If the healing from Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon to maintain healing reduction through Brand P Blaze's damage over time.
RekSai.fight: Apply Brand P Blaze first, then trade by stunning her with Brand Q Sear. When Rek'Sai burrows to heal, keep Brand's damage over time on her. Do not move close first while Rek'Sai still has her mobility and knockup available.
RekSai.laning: Do not move alone through areas without vision, and do not push the lane too hard early. Place Brand W Pillar of Flame ahead of the enemy's movement when they step up for a last hit, then create distance after poking. Step on any visible Rek'Sai tunnels near the lane as you pass to destroy them.
RekSai.combo: If Rek'Sai is close, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration, then land Brand Q Sear to stun her. If you start from a distance, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame first, then use Brand Q Sear. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check its projectile path, and place Brand W Pillar of Flame where she is stunned.
RekSai.escape: Look for a fight after the knockup from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Unburrow and the mobility from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel have been used. If Rek'Sai R Void Rush is also down, apply Brand P Blaze and look for a stun with Brand Q Sear. If only one mobility option is down, do not chase too far; she can escape with the other.
RekSai.phase: Early on, focus on avoiding kills from Rek'Sai's ganks. Later, position so Brand is not picked off first and deal damage from the back.
RekSai.teamfight: From the back, when enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. Even if Rek'Sai is on the frontline, Brand P Blaze can deal damage based on maximum health, so do not move forward. If enemies spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Brand P Blaze on the frontline with Brand E Conflagration and Brand W Pillar of Flame.

Rell.watch: When Rell E Full Tilt speeds up Rell and an ally, treat it as an engage signal: stop trading and retreat outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range. If Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down catches Brand, he has no skill to escape on his own and can easily be hit by further crowd control. Sidestep the straight-line Rell Q Shattering Strike, and keep space between you and your allies so Rell R Magnet Storm cannot pull several of you together.
Rell.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rell deals mostly magic damage, and Brand has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Brand has no mobility skill and can easily be hit by Rell's crowd control in succession, so prioritize tenacity too.
Rell.fight: Stay outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range and apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame first. Look for a stun when Brand P Blaze is on Rell, Brand Q Sear is ready, and no minions block its projectile path. The window to go in comes after Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and Rell E Full Tilt are used.
Rell.laning: Rell has low magic resistance early and no way to restore health in lane, so chip away at her with Brand W Pillar of Flame from outside her engage range. Also poke the opposing marksman with Brand W Pillar of Flame when they step up for a last hit, but do not remain within Rell's engage range afterward. When Rell E Full Tilt speeds up Rell and her ally, stop poking and retreat.
Rell.combo: From a distance, apply Brand P Blaze to Rell with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun her with Brand Q Sear. If she is already close, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration and land Brand Q Sear.
Rell.escape: If only Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down, do not go in immediately; she can escape with Rell E Full Tilt. Before Rell E Full Tilt comes back, look for a window to apply Brand P Blaze to her and stun her with Brand Q Sear.
Rell.phase: Early on, watch for Rell's engage while chipping away at her health with the long range of Brand W Pillar of Flame. Later, stay in the back: if Brand is caught first, he cannot do anything.
Rell.teamfight: Before the engage, spread out from your allies so Rell R Magnet Storm cannot pull several of you together. From the back, if enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If they spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

Renata.watch: Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots the first enemy it hits and can throw them, so stay behind minions or your frontline to avoid the projectile. Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover makes allies attack each other if they are hit together, so keep your distance from allies while it is available. If you take down an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, back away to prevent that enemy from getting a takedown.
Renata.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Renata Glasc deals mostly magic damage, and Brand has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. Add Morellonomicon if enemy healing becomes a problem.
Renata.fight: When Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration. Follow with Brand Q Sear to stun her and focus your damage. Renata Glasc has no mobility ability, but Brand has low health, so do not stay within dangerous range after poking.
Renata.laning: Use Brand W Pillar of Flame to poke when Renata Glasc steps up for a last hit, placing it ahead of her movement. Apply Brand P Blaze to a minion, then use Brand E Conflagration to spread it to Renata Glasc if she is nearby. Use Brand Q Sear when the target has Brand P Blaze and no minion blocks the projectile.
Renata.combo: If you are already close, Brand E Conflagration → Brand Q Sear is faster. When several enemies are grouped, use Brand W Pillar of Flame → Brand E Conflagration to spread Brand P Blaze, then use Brand R Pyroclasm.
Renata.escape: Close the gap while Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down, apply Brand P Blaze, and stun her with Brand Q Sear. Renata Glasc has no mobility ability, so she has trouble escaping once you close the gap. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, do not go in grouped with allies.
Renata.phase: Renata Glasc has low health and attack damage early, but Brand also has low health, so keep your distance after poking. Later, position to avoid getting picked off first and deal area damage.
Renata.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies while Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, and save Brand R Pyroclasm if the enemies are spread out. Brand P Blaze also deals damage based on maximum health to the frontline, so do not move forward to target the backline.

Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from brush and build Ferocity, so avoid paths beside brush when he is out of sight. At full Ferocity, Rengar E Bola Strike can root you and Rengar W Battle Roar can remove crowd control, so avoid trading. When watching for Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt, do not travel alone while injured; stay with allies.
Rengar.build: Rengar deals mostly physical damage, and Brand has relatively low armor, so buy Cloth Armor first to survive. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and prioritize armor. Add Morellonomicon if the healing from Rengar W Battle Roar becomes a problem.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar has no Ferocity. Once Rengar W Battle Roar is down, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration and stun him with Brand Q Sear. When Rengar engages, counter his entry from the backline, but do not rely on the stun if empowered Rengar W Battle Roar is ready.
Rengar.laning: Use Control Ward to secure vision of brush, and do not pass beside brush when Rengar is out of sight. Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame, but do not remain within Rengar's engage range afterward. Look for an all-in when the enemy has Brand P Blaze and Brand Q Sear is available.
Rengar.combo: Against Rengar at close range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration, then land Brand Q Sear to stun him when no minion blocks the projectile. Focus your damage in this order after Rengar W Battle Roar is down.
Rengar.escape: Your chance to counterattack comes after you dodge Rengar E Bola Strike and Rengar W Battle Roar is down. Once Rengar engages, he has no ability to create distance on his own, so apply Brand P Blaze and hold him with the stun from Brand Q Sear.
Rengar.phase: Early on, watch for Rengar leaping from brush and survive with Cloth Armor. Later, stay close to allies and position to avoid getting picked off first.
Rengar.teamfight: Stand behind your frontline and within your team's vision to counter Rengar's engage. When Rengar W Battle Roar is down, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration and stun him with Brand Q Sear.

Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault dashes in and knocks you up, while Sejuani R Glacial Prison stuns, so dodge to the side when you see the windup. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, get out of range before the second strike, which deals heavy damage and slows. Sejuani E Permafrost also builds stacks from basic attacks by nearby allies, so move away as soon as you see the stacks building.
Sejuani.build: Sejuani deals mostly magic damage, and Brand has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Sejuani.fight: Brand has no escape ability, so do not move in first while Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is available. Apply Brand P Blaze to Sejuani and stun her with Brand Q Sear when no minion blocks the projectile. If Sejuani P Fury of the North has increased her defensive stats, deal damage once first, then continue attacking after her armor falls off.
Sejuani.laning: Poke from long range with Brand W Pillar of Flame, and do not linger within Sejuani's dash range. Brand E Conflagration spreads farther when used on a burning target, so set a minion ablaze to make it hard for Sejuani to stand nearby. Because poking uses a lot of mana, recover mana by last-hitting burning minions.
Sejuani.combo: From a distance, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, and continue stacking with Brand E Conflagration. If you are already close, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration and use Brand Q Sear. Minions block Brand Q Sear, and it cannot stun a target without Brand P Blaze, so check the projectile path and the target's Brand P Blaze status.
Sejuani.escape: Right after you make Sejuani use Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is Brand's chance to close the gap. If Sejuani E Permafrost and Sejuani R Glacial Prison are also down, apply Brand P Blaze, stun her with Brand Q Sear, and attack. If she still has crowd control available, keep your distance first.
Sejuani.phase: Sejuani's early kill and damage metrics are relatively low, so taking jungle priority and objectives to delay her item timing is effective. Later, focus on positioning because you cannot deal damage if you are caught first.
Sejuani.teamfight: From the backline, use Brand W Pillar of Flame to apply Brand P Blaze to the frontline, including Sejuani, then spread it with Brand E Conflagration. Use Brand R Pyroclasm when enemies gather in a tight space to build stacks across them and trigger Brand P Blaze explosions. If they spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

Shaco.watch: If Shaco Q Deceive gets him behind you, his empowered basic attack hits you, and the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box and slow from Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison make it hard to create distance. Watch for boxes in brush and around objectives where you lack vision, and check first with Control Ward or Oracle Lens. Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage when your health is low, so do not take an unwarded path after a fight.
Shaco.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on to raise your magic resistance. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Shaco deals mostly magic damage, and Brand has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Shaco.fight: Focus Shaco with your allies immediately after he enters with Shaco Q Deceive and reveals himself. Apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration, then land Brand Q Sear from an angle where minions cannot block it to stun him. Do not close the gap first while Shaco Q Deceive is available, since Brand has no mobility ability.
Shaco.laning: Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame, but keep your distance after using it when Shaco is out of sight. Maintain vision at the entrance to your team's jungle to prepare for Shaco's early ganks and invades. Assume Shaco W Jack In The Box is in unwarded brush, and do not enter without checking.
Shaco.combo: When starting from a distance, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then use Brand Q Sear, checking for minions in front of the projectile.
Shaco.escape: Right after Shaco uses Shaco Q Deceive to enter is Brand's chance to counterattack. Avoid the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box; if Shaco has Brand P Blaze, stun him with Brand Q Sear and take him down with your allies. If you miss that window, keep your distance again because Brand has no escape ability.
Shaco.phase: Early on, watch for Shaco's ganks and invades, avoid giving up kills, and maintain vision at the entrance to your team's jungle. Later, Shaco's ability to fight alone falls off, but Brand is also ineffective if caught first, so stay in the backline.
Shaco.teamfight: From the backline, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame when enemies overlap, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. When Shaco reveals himself after entering with Shaco Q Deceive, focus him immediately with your allies and stun him with Brand Q Sear if he has Brand P Blaze. When the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate dies, back away from that spot to avoid the explosion and boxes.

Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions to slow and heal, so move out of the line between Senna and her target. If Senna W Last Embrace hits you, move away from allies while its mark is visible, before the root takes hold. If an auto attack or ability has hit you once, back off to avoid a second hit. When Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, watch for camouflaged enemies approaching; retreat or pressure the mist's area with Brand W Pillar of Flame.
Senna.build: Senna deals mostly physical damage, and Brand has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to survive. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and prioritize armor. If the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Senna.fight: When Senna steps forward to collect a soul or last-hit, set her on fire first with Brand W Pillar of Flame. Look for a stun when Brand P Blaze is on Senna and no minion blocks the path of Brand Q Sear. If Senna W Last Embrace hits you, create distance before the root takes hold.
Senna.laning: When a soul appears, Senna has to step forward, so watch its position in advance and poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame. If Senna stands near a minion, set the minion ablaze, then spread Blaze with Brand E Conflagration. After poking, get out of the line of Senna Q Piercing Darkness and watch your position behind minions so you can block Senna W Last Embrace.
Senna.combo: Against a distant Senna, set her on fire with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun her with Brand Q Sear from an angle without minions in its path. If she is close, set her on fire first with Brand E Conflagration, land Brand Q Sear, then place Brand W Pillar of Flame where she is stunned. Using Brand Q Sear first will not stun her.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace is used or blocked by a minion, you have a chance to close the distance. Senna E Curse of the Black Mist increases movement speed, so watch her movement and line up Brand Q Sear. Even when engaging, you must set Senna on fire first for Brand Q Sear to stun her.
Senna.phase: Senna has very low health early, so pressure her while denying soul collection. Later, her range and attack damage grow, while Brand is easy to pick off first, so stay in the back.
Senna.teamfight: When enemies group up, set them on fire from the back with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. The area damage from Brand P Blaze scales with maximum health and is effective against the frontline, so do not move forward to target Senna. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, retreat or use area abilities on the mist to stop the approach.

Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you are slowed, move out of the line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it touches an allied champion, so spread out sideways from your teammates in teamfights.
Seraphine.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Seraphine deals mainly magic damage and Brand has fairly low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Seraphine.fight: The moment after you dodge Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to trade. Look for when Seraphine is alone, separated from her allied marksman. Apply Blaze first, then stun her with Brand Q Sear. Brand has no escape ability, so keep your distance while waiting for an opening.
Seraphine.laning: When Seraphine steps forward to last-hit, poke her with Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block. Brand W Pillar of Flame detonates after a warning, so place it ahead of her movement. After poking, do not stay within range of Seraphine E Beat Drop.
Seraphine.combo: If you start from far away, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun with Brand Q Sear when there are no minions in the projectile’s path. If you start up close, apply Blaze first with Brand E Conflagration, then land Brand Q Sear.
Seraphine.escape: Close the distance right after Seraphine E Beat Drop misses. Seraphine has no mobility ability, so engage when Blaze is applied and you have a clear path to hit Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear only stuns targets that are burning, and minions block it.
Seraphine.phase: Early, survive with magic resistance and focus on poking with Brand W Pillar of Flame. Later, position to avoid being caught first while dealing area damage.

Shyvana.watch: Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is an unstoppable dash, so do not try to stop her with Brand Q Sear while she is flying in.
Shyvana.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Shyvana's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana when her Fury bar is empty, and don’t start an objective if it’s full. If she engages with Shyvana R Dragon’s Descent, apply Blaze after she lands, stun her with Brand Q Sear, then keep your distance as you attack.
Shyvana.laning: Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame from a safe distance, but do not remain close enough for Shyvana to reach you afterward. Look for chances to take camps and objectives first, before Shyvana builds stacks early.
Shyvana.combo: When Shyvana lands, apply Blaze with Brand E Conflagration, stun her with Brand Q Sear, then layer Brand W Pillar of Flame. If you can start from far away, apply Blaze first with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then land Brand Q Sear when there are no minions in the projectile’s path.
Shyvana.escape: Do not attempt a stun during the dash of Shyvana R Dragon's Descent; catch her with Brand Q Sear after she lands. Counterattack when Shyvana returns to human form and loses her bonus health and empowered abilities.
Shyvana.phase: Shyvana is weakest early, before she has stacks, so pressure her then. Later, her permanent stacks build up and Brand is easy to pick off first, so focus on positioning.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out from your teammates so several of you are not hit by the path of Shyvana R Dragon's Descent or her area abilities. When enemies group up, set them on fire from the back with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If Shyvana engages, stun her with Brand Q Sear after she lands, and deal Blaze explosion damage to the frontline too.

Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns multiple targets in a line, so spread out sideways from your teammates when Sona steps forward. If Sona suddenly moves into auto attack range, watch for the empowered auto attack from Sona P Power Chord and create distance.
Sona.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Sona's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Sona W Aria of Perseverance becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Sona.fight: Trade when Sona steps forward to apply her aura. Set her on fire first, then stun her with Brand Q Sear to deal follow-up damage before she can create distance with Sona E Song of Celerity. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check its path.
Sona.laning: Poke Sona with Brand W Pillar of Flame while she is weak early, keep trading, and pressure her mana. If Sona stands near a minion, you can set the minion on fire, then spread the damage with Brand E Conflagration. After poking, do not stay within Sona's range.
Sona.combo: From range, set Sona on fire with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun her with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand E Conflagration. If Sona is already on fire and close, use Brand E Conflagration followed quickly by Brand Q Sear. Using Brand Q Sear first on Sona when she is not on fire will not stun her.
Sona.escape: Engage when Sona R Crescendo is down and Sona steps forward. Close the distance before Sona E Song of Celerity activates, then set her on fire and stun her with Brand Q Sear to stop her escape.
Sona.phase: Pressure Sona aggressively early, before she builds up her scaling stacks. Later, Sona's scaling and team healing grow stronger, so position Brand to avoid being picked off first.
Sona.teamfight: When enemies group up, set them on fire from the back with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If the enemies spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep the frontline on fire. Do not stand in line with your teammates where Sona R Crescendo can hit you together.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact charges through terrain and can stun you if it hits a wall, so avoid standing with your back to one. If he catches you, Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval empowered basic attacks and Skarner P Threads of Vibration damage follow, so keep him out of melee range. Skarner R Impale suppresses you, so stay outside its range.
Skarner.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for magic resistance. Skarner's main damage is magic, but Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and Skarner E Ixtal's Impact deal physical damage, so spacing still matters. Decide in advance whether to build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar against the suppression from Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.fight: Look for a trade when Brand P Blaze is on Skarner and you have a clear shot with Brand Q Sear. Right after Skarner uses Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, his charge is unavailable, giving you a chance to stun him with Brand Q Sear. Do not move close to stack Brand P Blaze; land your follow-up abilities, then keep your distance.
Skarner.laning: Poke from a distance with Brand W Pillar of Flame, placing it ahead of Skarner's movement. If Skarner stands near minions, use Brand E Conflagration on a burning minion to spread the fire to him. Save Brand Q Sear for a stun when Skarner is already burning and no minion blocks its path.
Skarner.combo: From long range, ignite Skarner with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun him with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand E Conflagration. If Skarner is already burning and nearby, quickly follow Brand E Conflagration with Brand Q Sear. In either order, he must be burning before Brand Q Sear hits for the stun.
Skarner.escape: Right after you make Skarner use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your chance to close the distance or pick him off. Ignite him with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration, then stun him with Brand Q Sear if the projectile has a clear path. If Skarner R Impale is still available, stay outside its short range.
Skarner.phase: Early, watch for Skarner's ways to catch you and prioritize magic resistance and spacing. Late, stay in the backline: if you get caught first, you will struggle to contribute.
Skarner.teamfight: From the backline, wait for enemies to group around Skarner. Ignite them with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread the fire with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. The area damage from Brand P Blaze scales with maximum health and works against frontliners like Skarner, so do not move forward to reach the backline. If enemies are spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep the frontline burning with Brand E Conflagration and Brand W Pillar of Flame.

Swain.watch: Swerve clear of Swain E Nevermove until it disappears; its returning wave can catch you too. Swain Q Death's Hand hits with more bolts up close, so keep your distance. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, leave its range and wait for it to end.
Swain.build: Swain's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. If his healing becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon to your build.
Swain.fight: Trade right after Swain E Nevermove is down. First apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration, then stun with Brand Q Sear from an angle that minions don’t block. Don’t keep fighting nearby while Swain R Demonic Ascension is active.
Swain.laning: Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame early to limit Swain’s growth. Keep your distance from Swain, and look for an angle to spread Brand E Conflagration to him by applying Blaze to a minion. After poking, don’t stay in the path of Swain E Nevermove’s return.
Swain.combo: From range, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then use Brand E Conflagration. If you’re already close, apply Blaze with Brand E Conflagration first, then use Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear stuns only if Swain is burning and no minions are in the projectile’s path.
Swain.escape: The moment to engage is right after you dodge the returning wave of Swain E Nevermove. Swain has no mobility or escape ability, so if you apply Blaze and stun him with Brand Q Sear, it’s hard for him to get away.
Swain.phase: Take control of the lane early, before Swain builds up his growth stacks. Late, Swain grows tougher while Brand is easier to pick off first, so focus on positioning.
Swain.teamfight: From the backline, when Swain overlaps with another enemy, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. While Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, don’t keep fighting nearby; move out of range. If enemies are spread out and Brand R Pyroclasm is unlikely to bounce, save your ultimate and keep Blaze on the frontline.

Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley cannot change direction during its cast, so sidestep instead of retreating in a straight line.
Taliyah.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Taliyah's main damage is magic and Brand has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Taliyah.fight: Brand has no escape skill, so trade from outside the range of Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah W Seismic Shove. Keep fighting after applying Blaze to Taliyah when you can land Brand Q Sear.
Taliyah.laning: Use Brand W Pillar of Flame, which isn't blocked by minions, to punish Taliyah when she steps forward. Applying Blaze to a minion can let Brand E Conflagration spread to Taliyah, but back off after poking so you don't get caught by her crowd control.
Taliyah.combo: Up close, first apply Blaze to Taliyah with Brand E Conflagration, stun her with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand W Pillar of Flame. From farther away, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then hit Brand Q Sear when there are no minions in its path.
Taliyah.escape: After Taliyah E Unraveled Earth or Taliyah W Seismic Shove is down, Brand has a chance to close the distance. If Taliyah R Weaver's Wall isn’t back yet, apply Blaze to her, stun her with Brand Q Sear, and keep fighting.
Taliyah.phase: Brand's damage peaks in the midgame as he builds ability power. Late, focus on positioning: if you get caught first, you cannot deal damage.
Taliyah.teamfight: From the backline, dodge Taliyah’s crowd control. When enemies overlap, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If enemies are spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Blaze on the frontline.

Soraka.watch: Soraka Q Starcall slows Brand and heals Soraka, so poke while avoiding it. Stay out of Soraka E Equinox: it can silence and root you. Soraka R Wish heals allies regardless of distance, so account for it even when you see a chance for a kill.
Soraka.build: Early, use Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads. Soraka's damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first. If her healing becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon.
Soraka.fight: After Soraka uses Soraka E Equinox, ignite her with Brand P Blaze and stun her with Brand Q Sear as you fight. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check that its path is clear. Chain your abilities to deal burst damage before Soraka R Wish heals it back.
Soraka.laning: Poke the opposing marksman with Brand W Pillar of Flame when they step up to last-hit, forcing Soraka to use Soraka W Astral Infusion. It costs Soraka her own health, so keep up the pressure while dodging Soraka Q Starcall. Do not stay within the opponents' range after poking.
Soraka.combo: From range, ignite Soraka with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun her with Brand Q Sear, then add a stack with Brand E Conflagration. If she is already close, ignite her with Brand E Conflagration and follow with Brand Q Sear. Place Brand W Pillar of Flame ahead of her movement to make it easier to land.
Soraka.escape: When Soraka uses Soraka E Equinox to poke or push the wave, you have a chance to go in. Close the distance before stepping into its area, then stun the burning Soraka with Brand Q Sear. Soraka has no dash, but dodge Soraka Q Starcall: if it hits, you are slowed and she gains movement speed.
Soraka.phase: Early, survive with magic resistance and poke mainly with Brand W Pillar of Flame. Late, position to avoid being picked off first and deal damage from the backline.
Soraka.teamfight: From the backline, when enemies group up, ignite them with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread the fire with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If Soraka keeps healing them, target her, but do not step forward to catch her. If enemies are too spread out for Brand R Pyroclasm to bounce, save it and keep Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

Taric.watch: When you see Taric E Dazzle wind up, move sideways to dodge it. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance makes enemies immune to damage, stop attacking and use Brand Q Sear to stun them while you wait for the immunity to end.
Taric.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, then choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Taric P Bravado and Taric E Dazzle deal magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. If the healing from Taric Q Starlight's Touch becomes a problem, fit Morellonomicon into your build.
Taric.fight: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, keep your distance and trade damage. When Taric is affected by Blaze and Brand Q Sear is available, stun him and attack. Do not commit your damage while Taric R Cosmic Radiance makes enemies immune to damage.
Taric.laning: Keep your distance so Taric cannot reach a target to auto attack, and manage the minion wave to make it hard for him to approach. Poke from afar with Brand W Pillar of Flame, but do not stay in range of Taric E Dazzle afterward. Trade damage while Taric E Dazzle is on cooldown.
Taric.combo: Apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration, then stun with Brand Q Sear. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check that the projectile has a clear path. Use Brand E Conflagration during the stun, then land Brand W Pillar of Flame when it is available again.
Taric.escape: Taric E Dazzle being on cooldown is your chance to go in. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so stun him with Brand Q Sear while he is affected by Blaze and attack.
Taric.phase: Mid game is when Brand is strongest after building ability power. Late game, position safely to avoid getting caught first while dealing area damage.
Taric.teamfight: From the backline, when enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance makes enemies immune to damage, buy time with the stun from Brand Q Sear and deal damage again after the immunity ends. If enemies are spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Blaze on the frontline.

Thresh.watch: If Thresh Q Death Sentence catches you, Thresh E Flay can follow, making escape difficult. Move sideways when you see him raise his scythe, and change direction once more when stepping up for a last hit. Do not stand on the line between Thresh and his ally, either.
Thresh.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Thresh’s main damage is magic, so Brand should prioritize magic resistance. The follow-up attacks after you’re caught are also dangerous, so get tenacity.
Thresh.fight: Trade immediately after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence sideways. Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame when Thresh steps forward to collect a soul, and stun with Brand Q Sear when he is burning and no minion blocks the projectile. Do not go too deep if Thresh W Dark Passage is available.
Thresh.laning: Brand W Pillar of Flame is not blocked by minions, so aim it at Thresh when he steps forward to collect a soul. After poking, leave the threat range of Thresh Q Death Sentence and Thresh E Flay. Save Brand Q Sear for when it can stun.
Thresh.combo: From long range, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand E Conflagration. At close range, apply Blaze first with Brand E Conflagration, then land Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear stops at the first enemy it hits, so check that no minion blocks the projectile.
Thresh.escape: Immediately after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence is your chance to close the distance. He can escape with Thresh W Dark Passage, so look for a window when it is on cooldown to stun him with Brand Q Sear. If Thresh E Flay is available, watch your position so he cannot pull you toward his allies.
Thresh.phase: Early on, the risk of getting caught is high, so keep your distance and poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame. Late game, position in the backline to avoid getting picked off first.
Thresh.teamfight: Wait in the backline for enemies to group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If Thresh W Dark Passage appears, use your finishing ability immediately or back off. If Thresh R The Box traps you, choose an escape direction and let a durable ally break through one wall first.

Viego.watch: The dash and stun from Viego W Spectral Maw are dangerous, so dodge sideways when you see him charging it. If he is already affected by Blaze and no minion blocks the projectile, interrupt the charge with Brand Q Sear. When you see black mist, watch for Viego E Harrowed Path and avoid its path.
Viego.build: Viego's main damage is physical and Brand has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. If a prolonged duel makes the healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King a problem, add Morellonomicon after building armor.
Viego.fight: Trade when Brand can build up Blaze stacks. Apply Blaze to Viego first, stun him with Brand Q Sear, then land Brand W Pillar of Flame during the stun. If Viego is likely to get a kill in a small skirmish, do not start it; back off.
Viego.laning: Poke from long range with Brand W Pillar of Flame, but do not stay within Viego's engage range afterward. If you see the black mist from Viego E Harrowed Path along terrain, place a Control Ward or go around its path, and do not push the lane toward it. Applying Blaze to a minion can let Brand E Conflagration spread to Viego nearby.
Viego.combo: From long range, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun with Brand Q Sear. Up close, apply Blaze first with Brand E Conflagration and look for the same stun. Brand Q Sear stops at the first target, so check that no minion stands in the projectile's path to Viego. During the stun, land Brand W Pillar of Flame to build Blaze stacks.
Viego.escape: Treat Viego W Spectral Maw being on cooldown as an opening to go in, but do not rush the chase if Viego R Heartbreaker is available. If Viego R Heartbreaker is also still on cooldown, apply Blaze and stun with Brand Q Sear to give him less room to escape.
Viego.phase: Early on, survive with Cloth Armor and do not give Viego a kill. Late game, position in the backline to avoid getting picked off first.
Viego.teamfight: From the backline, when enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If enemies are spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Blaze on the frontline. If an ally falls in front of Viego, move away from that spot and look for a chance to stun him so he cannot possess them.

Velkoz.watch: Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission splits and hits to either side, so after dodging the initial projectile, do not keep moving only sideways; move toward Vel'Koz or behind where the projectile has passed. If Vel'Koz W Void Rift and Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption hit you in succession, the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction will trigger. When stacks build up, back off and let them expire. When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, hit Vel'Koz with Brand Q Sear while he is burning to interrupt the channel.
Velkoz.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, then choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vel'Koz deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Resistance cannot stop the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction and Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray, so prioritize avoiding consecutive ability hits.
Velkoz.fight: Close the distance and fight after Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption misses. Apply Blaze first with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration, then land Brand Q Sear to stun him and keep dealing damage during the stun. After one poke, do not remain within Vel'Koz's ability range.
Velkoz.laning: Brand W Pillar of Flame is not blocked by minions, so aim it ahead of Vel'Koz's movement when he steps forward. Applying Blaze to a minion before using Brand E Conflagration increases its spread range, which can let it reach Vel'Koz beside the minion. Use Brand Q Sear when Vel'Koz is burning and no minion blocks the projectile.
Velkoz.combo: From range, apply Blaze to Vel'Koz with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then build stacks with Brand E Conflagration. If you are already close, Brand E Conflagration into Brand Q Sear is faster. Keep that order: if Brand Q Sear arrives first, it will not stun.
Velkoz.escape: Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption being on cooldown is your chance to go in. Apply Blaze to Vel'Koz first, then stun with Brand Q Sear; without a mobility ability, he will have trouble escaping. If you get very close, Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock you away, so confirm it has missed before going in.
Velkoz.phase: Mid game is when Brand is strongest after building ability power, so start fights where you can build Blaze stacks. Late game, position in the backline so Brand, with his low health and no mobility ability, does not get caught first.
Velkoz.teamfight: From the backline, when enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, prioritize interrupting it by landing Brand Q Sear on Vel'Koz while he is burning. If enemies are spread out and Brand R Pyroclasm is unlikely to bounce between them, save it and keep Blaze on the frontline with Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand E Conflagration.

Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker charges forward and knocks you back, so move backward or sideways when you see her charging it. Vi R Cease and Desist follows its target all the way, knocking them up and stunning them, so do not venture alone out of vision while she has it available. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor with repeated hits, so avoid extended fights.
Vi.build: Vi deals mainly physical damage and Brand has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor and build armor first. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Vi W Denting Blows deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only a large amount of health.
Vi.fight: If Vi engages with Vi P Blast Shield active, wait for the shield to wear off before trading. Right after dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun her with Brand Q Sear, and make a short trade. Back away immediately to avoid repeated hits from Vi W Denting Blows.
Vi.laning: When you see Vi Q Vault Breaker charging, prioritize creating distance over harassing. Place Brand W Pillar of Flame ahead of the opponent’s movement, and after casting it, stay outside Vi’s engage range. Use Brand Q Sear to stun only when the opponent is ablaze and no minions are in the projectile’s path.
Vi.combo: After Vi Q Vault Breaker misses, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame and hit Vi with Brand Q Sear to stun her. If she is already close, apply Blaze with Brand E Conflagration first, then use Brand Q Sear. Keep this order: Brand Q Sear will not stun if you cast it first.
Vi.escape: Right after you dodge Vi Q Vault Breaker, her dash is unavailable; use that opening to back away or counterattack. Vi cannot be stopped while charging in with Vi R Cease and Desist, so do not waste Brand Q Sear during it. After she lands and the knockup ends, stun her with Brand Q Sear if she is affected by Blaze, then create distance.
Vi.phase: Early on, be especially careful of Vi's engages because Brand has low armor and no mobility skill; use Cloth Armor to survive. Later, stay in the back, since you cannot deal damage if you get caught first.
Vi.teamfight: Stay in the back, watch for engages with Vi Q Vault Breaker and Vi R Cease and Desist, and remain within range of your allies' protective abilities. When enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If they are spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Blaze on the front line.

Udyr.watch: Udyr Q Wilding Claw strengthens his basic attacks at close range and deals damage based on maximum health, so do not fight him for long. The slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm also makes it harder to keep your distance.
Udyr.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Udyr deals mainly physical damage and Brand has low armor, so build armor first. If the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon.
Udyr.fight: Use Brand W Pillar of Flame to chip away at Udyr's health before he closes in, but save Brand Q Sear to stop his approach. Apply Blaze first, stun him with Brand Q Sear, then follow up with damage.
Udyr.laning: Udyr can appear from the jungle to gank, so keep vision on key routes and jungle entrances, and do not push forward when he is missing. Brand W Pillar of Flame is not blocked by minions, so use it to poke from a safe distance.
Udyr.combo: From range, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun Udyr with Brand Q Sear. If he is already close, apply Blaze with Brand E Conflagration and hit him with Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear is blocked by minions, so check its projectile path, then place Brand W Pillar of Flame where he is stunned.
Udyr.phase: Early on, watch for Udyr's approach, maintain vision, and survive by building armor. Later, position in the back and deal area damage, since you are vulnerable to being caught first.
Udyr.teamfight: Wait in the back for enemies to group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If they spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Blaze on the front line. Do not chase Udyr forward when defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle make him durable; deal with vulnerable enemies you can reach first.

Warwick.watch: Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast and Warwick R Infinite Duress close the gap, and Warwick R Infinite Duress suppresses you if it hits. Warwick takes much less damage while Warwick E Primal Howl is active, and its fear will trigger, so back away and respond after the fear goes off. If your health falls below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your location, so do not overstay.
Warwick.build: Much of Warwick's main damage is magic damage and Brand has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Warwick's healing becomes a problem, fit in Morellonomicon to keep Grievous Wounds active longer through Brand P Blaze.
Warwick.fight: Brand has no escape skill, so keep your distance from Warwick while fighting. Save your burst while Warwick E Primal Howl is active, then follow up with abilities after the fear goes off. When Warwick is affected by Blaze and Brand Q Sear has a clear path, stun him and continue dealing damage.
Warwick.laning: Poke with Brand W Pillar of Flame, which is not blocked by minions, by aiming ahead of Warwick's movement. Brand W Pillar of Flame costs a lot of mana and can be dodged on foot, so stay outside Warwick's dash range after using it. If your health drops below half, recall even if it means giving up some farm, since Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals you.
Warwick.combo: From range, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame first, then stun Warwick with Brand Q Sear. If he is already close, apply Blaze with Brand E Conflagration before hitting him with Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear is blocked by minions, so make sure the projectile has a clear path, then place Brand W Pillar of Flame on him while he is stunned.
Warwick.escape: Do not engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. Wait for an opening when Warwick R Infinite Duress is also down, then fight by stunning him with Brand Q Sear after the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl goes off.
Warwick.phase: Later, maintain your position so you do not get caught first, and deal area damage.
Warwick.teamfight: Stay in the back, respect Warwick's engage range, and deal damage based on maximum health even to the front line. When enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If an ally is caught by Warwick R Infinite Duress, focus your counterattack on Warwick while he is locked in place.

Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so change direction and dodge sideways when you see him charging it. Watch out for the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction and the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb; especially avoid getting stunned and hit by follow-up attacks. Start dodging immediately when you see Xerath begin casting Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.
Xerath.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath deals mainly magic damage and Brand has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.fight: Dodge sideways and close the gap while Xerath charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse. If Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration, then look for a stun with Brand Q Sear.
Xerath.laning: Poke Xerath with Brand W Pillar of Flame, which is not blocked by minions, when he steps forward. After using it, do not stay within his range. Farm while avoiding his heavy damage; when he runs low on mana, push the wave and call your jungler. If Xerath stands near a burning minion, look to spread Brand E Conflagration to him.
Xerath.combo: From range, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame first, stun Xerath with Brand Q Sear, then follow up with Brand E Conflagration. If he is already close, Brand E Conflagration into Brand Q Sear is faster. Use Brand Q Sear when Xerath is affected by Blaze and no minion blocks the projectile's path.
Xerath.escape: Right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used is your chance to close the gap. Xerath has no mobility skill, so once you are close, apply Blaze first and follow up with a Brand Q Sear stun. Xerath also cannot move while casting Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, so you can move in on his position.
Xerath.phase: Brand is strongest in the mid game once he has built up ability power. Later, position to avoid getting caught first and attack from the back.
Xerath.teamfight: From the back, when enemies group up, apply Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. Look for Brand R Pyroclasm to keep bouncing in narrow passages or among grouped enemies. If they spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Blaze on the front line.

XinZhao.watch: Sidestep the thrust at the end of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. If Xin Zhao closes in with Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge and hits you with two empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, Flash out of range before the third attack knocks you up. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, damage from outside his spear range will not affect him, so back away and wait for it to end.
XinZhao.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Xin Zhao deals mainly physical damage and Brand has low armor, so build armor first. If the healing from Xin Zhao P Determination becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon.
XinZhao.fight: Manage your distance first, since getting caught by Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge makes it easy for him to land follow-up hits. Trade when you can apply Brand P Blaze and land Brand Q Sear. Look for another chance to attack after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.laning: Harass with Brand W Pillar of Flame, placing it ahead of Xin Zhao’s movement since he can dodge after seeing its warning. Applying Brand P Blaze to a minion makes Brand E Conflagration spread farther and potentially reach Xin Zhao beside it. After harassing, back out of the dash range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
XinZhao.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame first, then stun with Brand Q Sear. If Xin Zhao is already close, applying Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration before using Brand Q Sear is faster. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check that the projectile has a clear path to Xin Zhao.
XinZhao.escape: Right after drawing out Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is your chance to close the distance or kill him. Land Brand Q Sear on Xin Zhao while Brand P Blaze is active to stun him. If you dodge the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning, you also remove the angle for him to engage with the extended range of Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge.
XinZhao.phase: Early on, account for Brand’s low armor and lack of escape tools, and avoid Xin Zhao’s engage. Later, position to avoid getting caught first and look for the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.teamfight: Deal area damage from the backline while keeping distance between Xin Zhao and your allies. When enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. Do not stand right beside your allies, so the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard does not split your formation; counterattack when his immunity ends.

Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot can knock you up after he charges and leaps. If you see him charging it behind a wall, move away from that spot. Brand has no mobility, and getting hit by Zac Q Stretching Strikes can leave him caught by follow-up attacks, so manage your distance first. Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on maximum health, so back away after Zac closes in.
Zac.build: Zac’s damage is mostly magic, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and build magic resistance. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If the healing from Zac P Cell Division becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon.
Zac.fight: Right after drawing out Zac E Elastic Slingshot is your chance to close the distance and fight. Apply Brand P Blaze first with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration, then stun him with Brand Q Sear. Step on the body chunks Zac drops as you pass to deny his healing.
Zac.laning: Harass with Brand W Pillar of Flame, but keep your distance afterward in case Zac engages with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Look to trade when Zac has Brand P Blaze on him and Brand Q Sear is available. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check the projectile’s path.
Zac.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then follow with Brand E Conflagration. If Zac is already close, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration first, then land Brand Q Sear. To interrupt the charge of Zac E Elastic Slingshot, Zac must have Brand P Blaze on him and Brand Q Sear must reach him without hitting a minion.
Zac.escape: Right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is used is your window to engage. While Zac cannot immediately escape with a mobility ability, apply Brand P Blaze and look for a stun with Brand Q Sear. Getting hit by Zac’s crowd control makes follow-up hits easy, so check your distance before engaging.
Zac.phase: Early on, build magic resistance first and watch for Zac’s engage. Later, hold a position where you will not get caught first while dealing area damage.
Zac.teamfight: From the backline, withstand Zac’s engage, then back away to avoid damage from Zac W Unstable Matter. When enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If the pieces from Zac P Cell Division come close together, hit them together with area damage.

Zyra.watch: If Zyra E Grasping Roots roots you, plant damage and the knockup from Zyra R Stranglethorns may follow. Stay at the edge of its range and sidestep Zyra E Grasping Roots. When you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, immediately walk out of its area.
Zyra.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Zyra’s magic damage early on. Choose Mercury's Treads for magic resistance and tenacity.
Zyra.fight: Look for a moment after Zyra E Grasping Roots misses when no plants are nearby. Apply Brand P Blaze first with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration, stun her with Brand Q Sear, then continue dealing damage.
Zyra.combo: From range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, then stun with Brand Q Sear. If Zyra is already close, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand Q Sear. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check the projectile’s path.
Zyra.escape: Engage while Zyra E Grasping Roots is down after missing. Zyra has no mobility ability, so close the distance and land Brand Q Sear on her while Brand P Blaze is active to stun her.
Zyra.phase: Early on, watch for Zyra’s root and plant damage, and manage your distance. Later, focus on backline positioning to avoid getting caught first.
Zyra.teamfight: Avoid fighting where Zyra has built up seeds and plants; move the fight elsewhere. From the backline, when enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then use Brand R Pyroclasm. If enemies spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Brand P Blaze on the frontline.

Zilean.watch: If Zilean Q Time Bomb attaches to you, move away from allies and out of its blast radius. A second Zilean Q Time Bomb after Zilean W Rewind will stun you, so do not keep fighting where the first bomb landed. If Zilean E Time Warp slows you, you are more likely to take both the bomb combo and the enemy's damage.
Zilean.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zilean deals magic damage and Brand has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Zilean R Chronoshift becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon.
Zilean.fight: After that, watch for two Zilean Q Time Bombs and Zilean E Time Warp, and trade damage when Zilean's crowd control is down. Once Zilean has Brand P Blaze on him and Brand Q Sear has a clear path, stun him and follow up with damage.
Zilean.laning: Use Brand W Pillar of Flame, which minions cannot block, to harass Zilean as he steps forward. After harassing him, do not stay within range of his retaliation.
Zilean.combo: At range, apply fire with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then use Brand E Conflagration to build Brand P Blaze stacks. If you are close enough to land it reliably, Brand E Conflagration → Brand Q Sear is faster. Minions block Brand Q Sear, so check its path before casting.
Zilean.escape: The chance to close the gap comes after Zilean's second Q Time Bomb or Zilean E Time Warp is down. Zilean has no dash, so apply Brand P Blaze and look for a stun with Brand Q Sear then. If the first bomb is attached to you, first move away from allies and out of its blast radius.
Zilean.phase: Late game, position in the back so Brand does not get picked off first.
Zilean.teamfight: From the back, when enemies group up, apply fire with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then cast Brand R Pyroclasm. If they have spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and keep Brand P Blaze on the front line. If Zilean R Chronoshift is on an enemy damage dealer, switch your target to Zilean and do not use abilities on the reviving target.

Belveth.watch: If Bel'Veth closes in with Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, turn sideways to dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below instead of running straight back. If it hits, it knocks you up and slows you, and resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. Bel'Veth takes reduced damage while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, so use Brand's abilities after it ends.
Belveth.build: Bel'Veth's main damage is physical and Brand has low armor, so buy Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps. Armor does not prevent the magic damage from Bel'Veth W Above and Below or the true damage from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet. If the healing from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon.
Belveth.fight: Pressure Bel'Veth in early skirmishes before she builds stacks. Apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration, then stun her with Brand Q Sear from an angle where minions cannot block it. If Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom has started, wait for it to end instead of pouring in damage.
