Belveth.laning: Minions cannot block Brand W Pillar of Flame, so place it ahead of Bel'Veth's approach. If you apply Brand P Blaze to minions, Brand E Conflagration can spread farther and reach a nearby Bel'Veth. After harassing her, do not stay in her range; look for a fight when both Brand P Blaze and Brand Q Sear are ready.
Belveth.combo: At range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then use Brand E Conflagration to build stacks. If she is already close, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration and land Brand Q Sear.
Belveth.escape: Sidestep Bel'Veth W Above and Below to avoid its crowd control and the reset of Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, then look for an opening. Do not engage just because Bel'Veth used Bel'Veth Q Void Surge once; go in when you can apply Brand P Blaze and stun her with Brand Q Sear before that ability comes back. Use the fact that she cannot immediately dash again in the direction she just dashed when moving and aiming abilities.
Belveth.phase: Bel'Veth grows stronger as her stacks accumulate permanently, so late game Brand must hold his position while fighting.
Belveth.teamfight: From the back, when enemies group up, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then cast Brand R Pyroclasm. Save your high-damage abilities while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, and sidestep Bel'Veth W Above and Below. If an ally falls and drops Void Coral, retreat before Bel'Veth picks it up, and delay the teamfight while her transformation is active.

Nocturne.watch: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, do not stay isolated; move toward your allies immediately. Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror only triggers fear if its tether remains connected, so create distance as soon as it lands. Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability, so check whether his shield is active before trying to stun him with Brand Q Sear.
Nocturne.build: Nocturne's main damage is physical and Brand has low armor, so build armor first. Buy Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If the healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades becomes a problem, add Morellonomicon.
Nocturne.fight: Apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration, then stun with Brand Q Sear from an angle where minions cannot block it. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, remove the shield first and look for the stun when Brand Q Sear is available again.
Nocturne.laning: Use Brand W Pillar of Flame to poke your opponent as they step forward to last-hit, then stay out of their range. Keep vision around the river and jungle entrances so you have a retreat path before Nocturne R Paranoia activates. If you’re hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, don’t run straight along its trail; angle your movement toward an ally or turret.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, stun with Brand Q Sear, then use Brand E Conflagration. At close range, apply Brand P Blaze with Brand E Conflagration first, then land Brand Q Sear. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, Brand Q Sear can remove the shield but cannot stun him, so wait for another chance to stun.
Nocturne.escape: If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror tethers you, create distance to break the tether, then counterattack after avoiding the fear. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is also down, apply Brand P Blaze first and look for a stun with Brand Q Sear.
Nocturne.phase: Brand is strongest in midgame, when he has built up ability power. Late game, Brand is more likely to be picked off first, so position in the back and fight from there.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, move toward your allies and wait in the back for enemies to group up. Apply Brand P Blaze with Brand W Pillar of Flame, spread it with Brand E Conflagration, then cast Brand R Pyroclasm. If they have already spread out, save Brand R Pyroclasm and use Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand E Conflagration to keep Brand P Blaze on the front line.
